tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam

par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rgyal ba'i sras po'i tshul/ /rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin rgyal dang mdzad pa mtshungs/ /rgyal mchog mtshungs med rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ /rgyal de 'dren mchog rgyal bar yid gnyis spangs/ /gang zhig tshul khrims shin tu rnam par dag /gang 'di shes bya'i rnam pa kun la mkhas/ /gang la byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul yod/ /gang dag de gsum ldan pa phyag gi gnas/ /gang zhig nga rgyal phrag dog rtsub sems med/ /gang zhig chos dang dam pa mi spong pa/ /gang zhig rang gi yon tan ngom mi byed/ /gang zhig de de'ang dam pa yin phyir mos/ /gang zhig dgongs pa zab mo nges par 'grel/ /gang la sngon med yang dag lta bas mdzes/ /gang 'di rtse gcig sgrub la mngon par brtson/ /gang las rmad byung ya mtshan gus pa'i gnas/ /rton pa bzhi ldan kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ /nges pa'i don du sems dpa' che yin la/ /snang ngor gong du smos pa'i chos kun ldan/ /'brel tshad don mchog sbyor ba'i phrin las can/ /gang 'di'i grub mtha' rmad byung ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi nges gsang 'di/ /ring nas sbas pa slar spel phyir/ /de gsung rnam par bshad par bya/ /'dir ni gnas lugs 'khrul ba spangs pa yi/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i grub mtha' ma nor ba/ /skyon kun las grol dbu ma'i chos mchog ste/ /gang la 'jug pa'i yul 'di nges par bzung*/ / bla med byang chub sgrub la thun mong min pa'i rgyu/ /rnam par grol ba mchog dang bde ba'i rgyur 'gro ba/ /dad dang snying rje shes rab mtshungs med 'di las 'byung*/ /dgos pa gang gi phyir du 'jug pa de yin no/ /nges don mdo dang sa bcu'i dbang phyug dang*/ /drang nges 'byed par lung bstan 'phags pa'i mchog /thogs med zhabs te mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan bcas/

/spros bral rig par lung bstan klu sgrub sogs/ /dam pa'i gsung la legs par brten/ /shing rta chen por rlom zhing grags/ /rmongs pa'am gya gyu spyod rnams kyi/ /tshig ni yid ches min pas spangs/ /gsung rab don kun legs rtogs dang*/ /bdud kyi lam las 'da' ba dang*/ /las gyi sgrib pa zad 'gyur dang*/ /bsod nams dpag med phul byung thob/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur ba/ /'di la zhugs pa'i phan yon te/ /chos gzhan bskal par spyad las kyang*/ /'di ni yud tsam spyad pa'ang mchog /ji ltar 'jug tshul ci zhe na/ /tshad ma'i lung gi rjes 'brang zhing*/ /rigs pa'i yan lag tshang bas 'jug khas mi len pa'i g.yo sgyu bkag /gang la 'jug dang dgos pa gang phyir 'jug /gang la brten nas 'jug dang de la ni/ /zhugs pa'i phan yon ji ltar 'jug tshul te/ /thog mar dge ba'i ngo mtshar rnam lnga'o/ /don dam de bzhin nyid bdag dam pa'i bdag /don dam cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /bdag med bde gshegs snying po bdag gi mchog /gnas lugs dbu ma chen po 'gyur ba med/ /'di don ma rtogs rmongs shing 'khrul ba las/ /gzhi dus glo bur 'khor ba'i chos rnams shar/ /de 'dra rtogs pa'i tshul ni lam zhes bya/ /rang rang dri mas dag tshe 'bras bur btags/ /dbu ma'i don gyi mdor bstan 'di yin te/ /rtogs bya gnas lugs don gyi dbu ma dang*/ /rtogs byed nyams myong lam gyi dbu ma'o/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis ka dang po'i khongs su 'du/ /de la re zhig srid pa'i chos rnams ni/ snang grags kun rdzob rnam par shes pa'i yul/ /don dam dbyings ni ye shes spros pas dben/ /gdod nas zhi ba myang 'das chos nyid do/ /rnam shes ye shes rgyal khams so so dang*/ /kun rdzob don dam so sor bden tshul dang*/ /rang bzhin gcig kyang gcig las grol ba dang*/ /mtshan nyid 'gal yang tha dad pa las grol/ /ye shes 'gyur med ngo bos yod na yang*/

/gcig shos nam yang grub pa med pa'i phyir/ /med la gcig dang tha dad gang yang med/ /skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong yod ma yin/ /tshul 'di rtogs na theg chen mtha' dag rtogs/ /'di ma rtog pas rtag chad g.yang sar lhung*/ /bsod nams chen po'i don 'di go bar 'gyur/ /blo mchog rnams kyis 'di la nges pa rnyed/ /'tsho ba mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ /spyod pa'ang blang dor ma nor dbu ma ste/ /sgom pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug dbu ma yin/ /lta ba'i gnas skabs kun tu dbu ma sbyar/ /bdag dang byed pos stong pas yod mtha' spangs/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /sems rgyun tsam las nga bdag gzhan med phyir/ /rtag par gnas dang sngar byung chad pa med/ /kun brtags nam yang med mod 'khrul ngor snang*/ /kun rdzob tsam la ltos pa'i dbu ma'o/ /phyi rol don spang sems ni sna tshogs snang*/ /rnal 'byor pa yi kun rdzob dbu ma yin/ /sems de gsal bar 'char yang rang bzhin med/ /rnam grangs tsam gyi don dam dbu mar 'dod/ /yongs grub kho na gnyis kyi chos bral ba/ /don dam dbu ma zhes byar rgyal rnams bzhed/ /rnam pa thams cad nyid kyang mi 'gyur ba/ /de ni dbu ma'i mtshan nyid mthar thug yin/ /mkhas dang grub par rlom zhing khas len pa/ /phal cher zab don 'di la rab tu 'khrul/ /kun rdzob snang ba rten 'brel mi 'gal yang*/ /nges pa'i don du 'di dag gang yang med/ /de ltar ston pa'ang bden pa gnyis ka la/ /brten pa'i dbu ma yin te thun mong lags/ /'bras bu don dang sku gnyis yon tan las/ khyab dang rtag pa'i don gyi dbu ma'o/ /med par smra ba chad ltar 'gyur ba ste/ /gnyis min smra ba de dag lta ci smos/ /zhes pa dbu ma'i rang bzhin ngos bzung ba'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o// //rgyal bas phung khams skye mched mtha' yas gsungs/ /de 'dir snang grags chos kyi dbye ba ni/ /rdzas kyi dngos dang brtags pa'i dngos po

dang*/ /dngos po med pa zhes bya gsum du 'gyur/ /yang na gzugs phung yid kyi skye mched dang*/ /chos khams zhes bya gsum gyis bsdus pa ste/ /'byung ba'i khams dang snod kyis bsdus pa dang*/ /bcud kyis bsdus pas gzugs can thams cad bsdus/ /'byung ba rgyu dang yul dbang la sogs 'bras/ /mtho dman la sogs bkod pa'i khyad par yod/ /bstan yod thogs bcas thogs pa med pa ste/ /dngos brtags ma phye de gsum dbye bar 'gyur/ /yid kyi skye mched phyogs mthun bcas pa ni/ /sems yid rnam par shes pa gsum du 'dus/ / chos khams de la'ang mtshan gzhi'-i chos rnams dang*/ /mtshan nyid chos dang dngos med dbye bas gsum/ /de yi dang po la yang phung po gsum/ /tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum du 'dus/ /'du shes phyin ci log dang dag pa ba/ /yang dag pa yi 'du shes zhes bya'o/ /bdag tu 'du shes gsher ba chur 'du shes/ /mi rtag pa ru 'du shes byed sogs yin/ /mi sdug la sogs log pa'i 'du shes kyang*/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis yang dag yin par 'gyur/ /de phyir de 'dra'i dbye ba rtogs par bla/ /g.yeng ldan mnyam gzhag phra bar dbye ba'ang yin/ /lus ngag yid kyis dbye bas 'du byed de/ /re re'ang dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /nyon mongs lung ma bstan par bshad rnams kyang*/ /bsgribs subastan pas mi dge'i phyogs su bsdu/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum du/ /nyon mongs rigs rnams thams cad 'dus par 'gyur/ /nges 'byung snying rje tshul bzhin shes pa dang*/ /dad dang brtson 'grus mnyam par 'jog pa dge /'du shes yang dag las ni dge ba ste/ /phyin ci log las mi dge'i 'du byed skye/ /dag pa ba las lung bstan min 'du byed/ /'on kyang 'di ni phal cher grogs kyis bsgyur/ /yul dang dus dang dngos la brtags pa yi/ /mtshan nyid kun brtags rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid chos kyi skye 'gag gnas dang rgas/

/nad dang 'gyur dang che chung mtha' dbus dang*/ /mtho : dma' (《dzaṃ》 dman ) rgyu 'bras dus gsum dbye ba dang*/ /'gro 'ong shor thob mtshan nyid mtshon bya dang*/ /mtshan gzhi ming tshig yi ge la sogs dang*/ /rags dang dus kyi bkod pa'i khyad par dang*/ /rten dang brten pa rtsa ba yan lag dang*/ yan lag yan lag can dang tshig don dang*/ /'brel ba'i khyad par du ma 'dod rnams te/ /bdag gcig pa dang de las byung ba'am/ /nor dang bdag po'am rang bzhin 'gyur ba dang*/ /rgyu dang <rdza mkhan bum pa3gt; rgyu can lhan cig 'grogs pa dang*/ /gtso 'khor dman dang khyad 'phags gsal mi gsal/ /phan bya phan byed gnod bya gnod byed dang*/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi'i 'brel ba dang*/ /brjod bya rjod byed yul dang yul can dang*/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs chos don 'brel ba dang*/ /byed po las dang byed pa'i 'brel ba sogs/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes bar ma la sogs dang*/ /mtho dman bar ma la sogs rnam grangs dang*/ /myong ba po dang shes po mthong po dang*/ /byed po sems can gang zag skyes bu dang*/ /lha dang dmyal ba 'gro ba'i bkod pa dang*/ /skang lag mig sogs lus kyi bkod pa dang*/ /ri dang nags tshal khang khyim snod kyi bkod/ /snang mun la sogs nyer spyod bkod paste/ /'di dag rags pa dpyad pas dpyad 'gyur mod/ /ldog cha tha dad pas na so sor bzhag /de bzhin lo zla zhag dang bskal pa sogs/ /snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor gzugs kyi mtshams sbyor dang*/ /gzugs kyi nam mkha' yid ngo'i gzugs sgra sogs/ /bkres skom bza' dang longs spyod g.yo ba yang*/ /gnas skabs khyad par sna tshogs mang po dang*/ /grangs dang phyogs dus 'gal dang dgag dang sgrub/ /de dag thams cad rang rang ldog steng nas/ /dngos por yod min blos brtags tsam zhig go /phyogs dus la sogs gdags gzhi nges med dang*/ /bum pa'i skye sogs gzhi gcig la brten dang*/ /rgyu 'bras la sogs du mar brten pa ste/

/'dogs pa'i gzhi las dbye na gsum du 'dus/ /nam mkha' 'gog pa gnyis dang ma skyes dang*/ /zhig nas med sogs dngos po gzhan gyur dang*/ /bum pa'i spyi sogs dngos po la brten dang*/ /mi srid bum med spyi sogs dngos med gsum/ /kun kyang rnam par rtog pas brtags :bya (《dzaṃ》 cha ) tsam/ /yin phyir dngos po nyid dam dngos po yi/ /'brel ba'am mi mthun phyogs la blos bzhag pas/ /dngos po gzhan 'gyur kho nar 'dus pa yin/ /de ltar nyer gcig gzhi yi chos yin te/ /byis pa rnams ni med pa'i chos la spyod/ /shes bya'i mtshan nyid rtogs phyir bshad pa yin/ /lam la'ang rdzas gzhan de ru ma 'dus med/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis rnam grangs logs su phye/ /'jig rten lam ni thun mong chos yin te/ /thun mong min pa nyan rang theg dman dang*/ /theg chen rgyal ba'i gnas su bgrod byed do/ /dngos med 'dus ma byas su bshad pa rnams/ /rnam grangs pa yin brtags pa ba ru brjod/ /med pa'i phyir dang blo ngor dngos po la/ /brten pa'i phyir na 'dus ma byas dngos min/ /'dus ma byas dngos chos nyid don dam ste/ /'dus ma byas pa thob par gyis shig gsungs/ /med pa la ni ci zhig 'thob par 'gyur/ /'khrul ngo'i brtags cha thob kyang dgos pa ci/ /'dus byas nyer bzhi ma byas gcig nyid de/ /srid tshad mdo tsam bsdus pa nyi shu lnga/ /mya ngan 'das chen la sogs mthar thug gi /chos mchog rdzogs ldan lugs bzhin mdor bsdus pa'o/ /so so'i dbye ba mtshan nyid du ma rnams/ /gzhung lugs kun tu grags phyir 'dir ma bkod/ /'bras bu'i chos la kun rdzob gzhan snang dang*/ /gsar thob cha ni lam du 'dus pa yin/ /bde gshegs snying po 'bras bu dngos yin te/ /gzhi yang dngos yin chos min chos nyid yin/ /'on kyang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbye ba las/ /rigs su chad pa ma yin kun khyab po/ /snang ba gzugs can sems dang sems las byung*/

/ldan min 'du byed de bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /gzhi lnga shes bya'i gnas zhes phal cher 'dod/ /gzugs can snang ngo tsam yin don du med/ /phyi ma sel ngo bzhi pa'ang brtags pa tsam/ /'di dag kun la grags rung thun mong stai/ /don dam 'dus ma byas pa der ma 'dus/ / rang gzhan smra po phal gyis 'di ma rtogs/ /mu stegs dngos po rtag par 'dod pa dang*/ /rang sde dngos med rtag pa'i tha snyad byed/ /bden pa bzhi zhes rgyal bas kun tu bstan/ /skye ba sdug bsngal bden pa'i gtso bo ste/ /sred pa kun 'byung bden pa'i gtso bor 'dod/ /lam bden gtso bo yang dag lta ba yin/ / 'gog pa de bzhin nyid du shes par bya/ /ma dag snod bcud sdug bsngal bden pa ste/ /ci tsam nyer len phung po de tsam du/ /sdug bsngal nyid yin dbye ba gsum dang brgyad/ /brten pa'i snod dang nyer spyod rgyu yi snod/ /nye bar spyad bya gsum ni snod kyi chos/ khams gsum gnas gsum dag gi dbye bas phye/ / gzugs med khams kyang dman pa'i sgra ru 'thad/ /zag bcas las kun khams gsum nyon mongs kun/ /kun 'byung nyid yin sdug bsngal kyang de yin/ /lam dngos 'phags lam yin te tshogs sbyor yang*/ /byang phyogs pha rol phyin sogs mtshan gzhir 'dod/ /lam gyi snang ba'ang lam bden gyis bsdus shing*/ / 'gog pa spangs pa'i khyad par tsam yin zhes/ /'di dag thun mong rags pa'i dbang du byas/ /shes sgrib ma rig bag chags dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /nyon mongs dang ni zag med las de dag /kun 'byung phra mo rnam byang lam gyis bsdus/ / yid lus dbang bsgyur skye dang bsam mi khyab/ /'chi 'pho ba dang dag pa'i 'jig rten khams/ /rnam byang lam ste sdug bsngal phra mor brjod/ /chos nyid lam gyi rnam pa don dam lam/ /gdod ma'i chos dbyings ye shes 'gog bden te/ / theg chen thun mong min pa'i gsang gtam mo/ /chos sku'i zhing khams sku dang mdzad pa dang*/

/'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yon tan rang gnas pa'i/ /'phrin las 'dod yon mchod pa'i mtshan nyid sogs/ /rnam pa thams cad gdod ma'i 'gog bden yin/ /don dam 'gog bden mngon du gyur pa la/ /'bras bu thob ces skyes bu de la grags/ /rang gi rang bzhin rgyu lam 'bras las 'das/ /don dam lam dang don dam sdug bsngal dang*/ /don dam kun 'byung zhes bya 'gog bden yin/ /de de sdug kun lam gyi bden pa min/ /don dam 'gog pa 'gog yin gzhan ma yin/ /gdod nas bral zad 'gog pa'am 'gog gzhir 'dod/ rje btsun ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba mi pham mgon po byams pas gsungs pa/ yang dag min rtog yang dag min/ /yang dag ma yin min mi rtog /rtog min mi rtog ma yin pa/ /shes bya thams cad yin par brjod/ /ces pa shes bya'i yul thams cad spyi ldog nas gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o// //yang dag pa'i mtha' las brtsam ste tshigs bcad du rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ rtag tu gnyis bral 'khrul ba'i rten gang yin dang gang zhig rnam kun tu/ /brjod par nus ma yin zhing spros pa med pa'i bdag nyid de kho na/ / shes bya spang byar rang bzhin dri med 'dod gang rnam par sbyang bya ste/ /de ni nam mkha' gser dang chu ltar nyon mongs pa las rnam dag 'dod/ /'gro ba dag na de las gzhan pa'ang cung zad yod min la/ /'gro ba ma lus pa yang de la kun tu rmongs pa'i blo/ /yod pa kun nas spangs te med la mngon zhen gang yin pa/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i rnam pa tshabs chen 'di ko ji lta bu/ /zhes dbyings kyi don dang*/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes snying po'i don dang*/ skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /:gnas

(《dzaṃ》 gnod ) med rga ba med pa ste/ /de ni rtag dang brtan phyir dang*/ /zhi ba'i phyir dang g.yung drung phyir/ /nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang*/ /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes rtag pa'i don dang*/ ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ /de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang*/ /yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste/ / gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang*/ /bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes pa khyab pa'i don dang*/ lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs sbrang ma dang 'dra de 'joms pa la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba skyes bu bzhin/ /zhes pa rig pa'i don dang*/ gang phyir de ni chos sku de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /rgya mtsho che bzhin dpag med pa'i/ /yon tan rin chen mi zad gnas/ /dbyer med yon tan dang ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid phyir mar me bzhin/ /chos sku rgyal ba'i ye shes dang*/ /thugs rje'i khams ni bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snod dang rin chen chu yis 'di/ /rgya mtsho dang ni mtshungs par bstan/ /dri med gnas la mngon shes dang*/ /ye shes dri med de nyid dang*/ /rnam dbye med phyir mar me yi/ /snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs can/ /de rnams 'dri byed gang yin pa/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod/ /ces pa rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ / yod min med min de bzhin min gzhan min/

/skye dang 'gag med 'bri bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /'phel ba med cing rnam par dag pa'ang med/ /rnam par dag 'gyur de ni don dam mtshan/ /zhes pa spros pa med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin/ /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /phra phyir nye bar gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'di nye bar gos pa med/ /ces pa ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes pa zung du 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*/ /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras phyung dang*/ /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*/ /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bur/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas sgrib pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams de gnas/ / zhes pas rigs dang khams su yang bstan to/ /slob dpon klu yis bshad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang*/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med/ /de skad bshad pa'i med pa spros med de/ /gzhan du khyad gzhi med par khyad chos dpyod/ /sgyu ma lta bu la yang dpyad pas ci/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin dngos por dogs pa bcad/ /chos dbyings de ni bde gshegs snying po ste/ /rtag pa kun khyab rang rig ye shes dang*/ /rnam pa thams cad pa ste yongs gcod mtshan/ / spros dang bral zhing ma gos rnam bcad don/ /zung 'jug rang bzhin rigs dang don dam khams/ /de ltar de yi mtshan nyid rnam pa dgu/

/'di la don dam dbyings kyi gnas tshul dang*/ /rnal 'byor can la ji ltar snang tshul lo/ /'gyur na dngos po yin phyir rdzun pa ste/ /'gyur ba med pa yod phyir shin tu rtag / cha dang bcas la kun khyab mi srid cing*/ /cha med nye ring med pas khyab par 'thad/ /shes dang shes bya'i dbye ba med phyir dang*/ /rgyal bas mkhyen phyir rang dang rig par grub/ /rig kyang rig bya rig byed mi dgos te/ /gsher ba la yang gsher bya gsher byed med/ /gsher ba'i ngo bo tsam zhig 'jog pa ltar/ / rang nyid rig pa tsam 'di dgag nus su/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen dang dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /dbyings te rgyal ba'i mkhyen par tshad mas grub/ /de phyir yon tan mtha' yas ci phyir med/ /des ni shes bya mtha' dag shes pa'i phyir/ /shes bya kun gyi don dam rnam pa 'dzin/ /de phyir de la 'khor 'das rnam kun 'char/ / pha rol phyin kun mthun pa'i chos nyid pas/ /de goms pa las 'di yang mngon du 'gyur/ /nyon mongs kun gyi mi mthun chos nyid pas/ /de sbyangs dbang las 'di mngon 'gyur ba yin/ /rtog pa'i yul kun dag las 'das pa'i phyir/ /de ni spros dang brjod pa kun dang bral/ /yang dag min rtog gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ /de la gos pa mi srid de ma gos/ /mtshan nyid khegs nas mtshan gzhi khegs 'gyur te/ /lus bkag na ni lus ldan khegs 'gyur la/ /lus ldan bkag na mi la sogs pa khegs/ /de khegs na yang nam mkha' mi khegs bzhin/ /skye ba bkag pas skye ldan khegs 'gyur mod/ /skye med gnas lugs dgag par mi nus so/ /'di yi rigs pa gzhan rnams kun la sbyar/ /rtag khyab sogs dang spros bral 'gal ba med/ /stong dang stong min zung du 'jug pa ste/ /don la zung med phyir na 'jug pa'ang med/ /rnam dbyer med la de yi rnam gzhag byas/ /kun rdzob kyis stong ye shes kyis mi stong*/ /rnal 'byor can gyi blo dang go bstun nas/

/de ni rigs yin de ni khams kyang yin/ /thog med dus nas brgyud de 'ongs pa dang*/ /chos nyid kyis thob skye mched drug gi chos/ /de 'dra ba zhes khyad chos gsum ldan par/ gsungs dang dpe dgus sny-ing po bstan pa'i tshul/ /phal cher sgrub po'i blo ngor mthun tshul yin/ /sems can re rer snying po re re dang*/ /rgyun ldan tshul dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /sku dang thugs su 'dra mtshungs tsam gyi rigs/ /de yang lam gyis 'phel par 'gyur tshul sogs/ /rnal 'byor can la ji ltar snang tshul te/ /de la'ang skye 'phags mthong tshul so sor yod/ /de dag gnas tshul dbang du byas pa min/ /'di ni dus gsum khyab kyang dus dang bral/ /de phyir rgyun zhes bya ba 'dir mi 'dod/ /rgyun ni 'khrul ngo tsam du zad phyir med/ /ye shes ma 'khrul ngo bor yod phyir ro/ /so sor yod na 'khrul phyir de mi bden/ /dper na go sa tha dad gnas rdul bzhin/ /lam gyis 'phel ba'ang rang bzhin ma yin pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes glo bur ba nyid skyon/ /kun khyab kun gzhi yin pas chos kun gyi/ khams yin rnam kun pas na rigs kyang yin/ khams don gser khams gser rdo la khyab bzhin/ /rigs ni 'dra dang yang na gcig pa'i don/ /sangs rgyas kun tu khyab pa yin mod kyang*/ /cha shas re res so sor khyab min te/ /sangs rgyas rdzogs pas sems can re rer khyab/ /sems can sgrib pas bsgribs phyir de ma mthong*/ /nyin byed sprin gyis nam yang ma bsgrib mod/ /sa gzhi sprin gyis khebs tshe skye bo rnams/ /nyi ma sprin gyi sbubs nang gnas zhes smra/ /'gro ba'i bde gshegs snying po'ang de dang mtshungs/ /snying po med na chos nyid med par 'gyur/ /chos nyid med na chos can ga la yod/ /de med na ni mtshan nyid ྄'dzin pa med/ /de yang med na shes bya rig bya dang*/ /rtogs bya mthong ba la sogs med par 'gyur/ /med na kun rdzob ji ltar snang tsam la/

/skur mi 'debs zhes zer ba'ang bslu tshig tsam/ /snang na shes rig rtogs mthong med par 'gal/ / ma brtags snang ba tsam du chos nyid ni/ /yod kyang don dam bden par med do zer/ /snang ngor de 'dra yod na 'jig rten pa'i/ /skye bo rnams la chos nyid snang bar 'gyur/ /bden par med cing snang yang mi snang na/ /yod pa'i tha snyad tsam yang ga la 'thad/ /bden med snang na bslu chos kun rdzob ste/ /don dam de ni chos can yin par 'gyur/ /des na 'jig rten snang ngor 'di med de/ /ye shes ngor ni snang zhing bden pa yin/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi yin don dam phyir/ /kun gzhi ye shes nyid du dam pas dgongs/ /kun gzhi rnam shes snying por gsungs pa yang*/ /sor mo'i rtse mos zla ba mtshon pa dang*/ /gos dmar bstan pas skyes bu mtshon dang 'dra/ /blo zhan rnams kyis 'di don mi shes gsungs/ /rang gi ngo bor don dam mya ngan 'das/ /'di la dmigs pas zhi ba thams cad thob/ /gser yod na ni de yi g.ya' bzhin du/ /'khor ba thog tha med pa'ang de las shar/ /dbyings de 'khor ba'i rgyu ni min mod kyang*/ /de med na ni de yang mi srid pas/ /mkha' la rlung gi dkyil 'khor rten zhes ltar/ / 'khor ba'i gzhir gyur zhes pa'i rnam gzhag byas/ /glo bur mya ngan 'das pa'i dmigs pa ste/ /de'i yang gzhi dang rgyu zhes mkhas la grags/ /rten dang gzhi dang rgyu dang rigs zhes pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul yin/ /de der bshad pas don dam dbyings de yi/ /gnas tshul rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod phyir gsungs/ /rang bzhin rigs la sad dang ma sad med/ /de yod rgyu mtshan rgyas 'gyur skyes pa la/ /de yang sad ces rnam gzhag byas pa tsam/ /'di 'phel de yang 'phel ba'i tha snyad btags/ /thob yul med na chos kun 'bras bu med/ /yod kyang dngos med thob pas dgos pa ci/ /gsar skyes de ni zlog dang rgyun chad srid/

/yon tan rgyu yang nyung las 'bras mang na/ /phal cher rigs 'dra gsar skyes cis ma yin/ /skyon rnams yon tan gyur yang mi mnyam ste/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yon tan mtha' med phyir/ /de phyir gdod ma nyid la 'bras bur gzhag /sangs rgyas mi rtag chos sku med dgag dang*/ /snying po gtan med yang na bden med smra/ /snying po yon tan med dang chos 'dir smod/ /de dag tshe thung nad mang mdze nad can/ /nor nyams dbang thang nyams dang srid nyams dang*/ /blun lkug ngan 'gror skye zhes mdo las gsungs/ /'di don smra rnams tshe ring nad med bde/ /go 'phang mi g.yo rtag pa'i sku thob nges/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po chos kyi dbyings gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o// //slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ bdag dang chos su nyer 'dogs pa/ /sna tshogs dag ni gang byung ba/ /de ni rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /gyur pa de yang rnam gsum ste/ /rnam par smin dang ngar sems dang*/ /yul la rnam par rig pa'o/ /bag chags kun 'dus gsal rig tsam zhig dang*/ /bdag tu snang dang sna tshogs yul snang can/ /ji ltar chu phran du ma 'dus pa la/ /chu chen zhes grags de la rlabs 'khrugs na/ /rlabs dang chu bo'i khyad par dbye bar dka'/ /kun gzhi rnam shes chu bo chen po 'dra/ /thog med nas bsags bag chags chu kun 'dus/ /da lta'i bag chags gsar 'dres sa bon dang*/ /sngon dus 'dres pa'i rgyun ni rnam smin yin/ /rdzas kyi rnam dbye med de chu dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gsal ba yin mod yul rnams kyi/ /rnam pa mi gsal dmigs pa kun la dmigs/ /snod bcud ma lus ston pa'i mthu can te/ / mtha' yas de ni kun la mtshungs par yod/ /rnam shes bdun ni chu bo'i rlabs dang 'dra/ /gsal zhing rig pa'i rnam 'gyur de dag kyang*/ /rig pa'i tshul du kun gzhi dang mtshungs kyang*/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid de dag rnams la med/ /chu rlabs chu bo chu ru mtshungs mod kyang*/

/de la de yi mtshan nyid med pa bzhin/ /yang bshad pa/ de la kun gzhi rnam shes ni/ /rnam smin sa bon thams cad pa/ /de ni len pa dag dang gnas/ /rnam par rig pa mi rig pa/ /rtag tu reg dang yid byed dang*/ /rig dang 'du shes sems par ldan/ /de la tshor ba btang snyoms te/ /de ni ma bsgrib lung ma bstan/ /reg la sogs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de ni rgyun 'bab chu bo bzhin/ /dgra bcom nyid na de bzlog go /de la gnas te rab byung zhing*/ /de la dmigs pas yid ces bya/ /rnam shes ngar sems bdag nyid can/ /bsgrib la lung du ma bstan pa'i/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs/ /bdag tu lta dang bdag tu rmongs/ /bdag rgyal bdag tu 'du shes pa/ /gang du skyes pa de 'o gzhan/ /reg sogs kyang de dgra bcom med/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug na med/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam na'ang med/ /gsum pa yul rnam drug po la/ /dmigs pa gang yin de dag ste/ /mi dge dge dang gnyis min pa'o/ /kun tu 'gro dang bye brag nges/ /sems las byung ba dge ba dang*/ /de bzhin nyon mongs nye nyon mongs/ / tshor ba gsum dang de mtshungs ldan/ /lnga rnams rtsa ba'i rnam shes la/ /ji lta'i rkyen las byung ba ni/ /rnam shes lhan cig gam ma yin/ /chu la rlabs rnams ji bzhin no/ /yid kyi rnam shes 'byung ba ni/ /rtag tu'o 'du shes med pa dang*/ /snyoms par 'jug pa rnam gnyis dang*/ /sems med gnyid dang brgyal ma gtogs/ /rnam shes sa bon thams cad pa/ /phan tshun dag gi dbang gis na/ /de lta de ltar 'gyur bar 'gro/ /des na rnam rtog de de skye/ /las kyi bag chags 'dzin gnyis kyis/ /bag chags bcas pa snga ma yi/ /rnam par smin pa zad :na (《dzaṃ》 nas ) gzhan/ /rnam smin bskyed pa de yin no/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bstsal pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang*/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob par

'gyur/ /chos kun sa bon thams cad pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa kun gzhi ste/ /de bas kun gzhi rnam shes de/ /dam pa dag la ngas bshad do/ /len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes/ /'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ /rnam shes bdun dang ldan par yang*/ /'dzin pa gnyis kyis rab 'jug ste/ /yongs su shes pas bzlog par 'gyur/ /sems ni rang bzhin dang ba ste/ /rnyog par byed pa yid yin no/ /rnam par shes dang bcas pa'i yid/ /rtag tu bag chags 'debs par byed/ /yid kyi shes las byung ba yi/ /bag chags dri ma bzhin du ltos/ /sems ni ras yug dkar po 'dra/ /bag chags rnams kyis mi mdzes so/ / <rgyan stug las/> ji ltar zla ba skar tshogs dang*/ /lhan cig mkha' la gnas pa ltar/ /rnam shes rnams dang kun gzhi yang*/ /de dang lhan cig lus la gnas/ /ji ltar 'o ma gyur pa na/ /yon tan zho dang dar bar gnas/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'-i rnam shes kyang*/ /rnam par gyur na gzugs ltar gnas/ /theg chen mdo las rgyas par gzhan yang bstan/ /sde pa kun la grags pa'i mdo sde ni/ /gcig las 'phros par kun gzhi'i ming gis bstan/ /rtsa ba'i rnam shes phal chen sde lung las/ /'khor ba ji srid phung po sa ston sde'i/ /rnam smin rnam shes mang bkur gos dmar pa'i/ / srid pa'i yan lag rnam shes gnas brtan sde'i/ /de sogs theg pa che chung lung mang yod/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang bshad pa/ de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang*/ /brdzun yang bden pa lta bur ni/ /'gro dang 'ong bas rnam g.yo zhing*/ /rtag tu srid pa gsum po len/ /kun gzhi yod de bag chags gnas yod phyir/ /bag chags 'jog pa las gzhan kun gzhi med/ /de yod na ni de nyid 'grub pa ste/ /ming tsam la ni mkhas rnams rtsod pas ci/ /'on kyang gzhan la rig pas 'thad pa med/

/med la gnod byed yod la sgrub byed ston/ /sa bon gnas med chags sogs 'byung mi rigs/ /'byung na dgra bcom la yang der 'gyur ro/ /nyon yid kun gzhi med na med phyir dang*/ /tshogs drug mi brtan yang yang rgyun chad phyir/ /dbang po gzugs bcas gzugs med khams gnas skabs/ /mi 'dod bem por shes pa'i sa bon ni/ /'debs na ha cang thal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /mer mer po yi shes pa yid min te/ /dus gsum 'dus ma byas sogs dmigs mi nus/ /sems yid med phyir de la rkyen ma tshangs/ / brgyal dang snyoms 'jug gnyis dang gnyid 'thug la/ /shes pa yod na 'di yod grub pa ste/ /gnyid dang brgyal la shes med mngon sum 'gal/ /shes med lus bcad na yang sdig med 'gyur/ /gzhan la'ang shes pa yod de sad 'gyur phyir/ /srog kyang sems dang lus kyi sbyaur 'phrod de/ /dbang shes cha shas nyi tshe las gzhan med/ /yid shes gzugs ni rten pa min phyir ro/ /sems med skabs las sad pa'i sems de ni/ /kun gzhi med na nyer len med par 'gyur/ /dang por 'jug pa'i dus kyi de min te/ /'gags shing dus gzhan bar du chod phyir ro/ /de ni skad cig snga phyir mi mtshungs te/ /me yis bar med bsreg par byed pa dang*/ /bar med thos sogs brjed par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /brgyal sogs 'byung ba'i stobs las sems 'gag na/ /'byung gzhan dbang las skye bar thal 'gyur te/ /sems kyi dngos po 'byung ba'i byed can 'gyur/ /de phyir sems med sems kyi rnam 'gyur yin/ /tshogs drug med phyir kun gzhi las gzhan min/ /'di med na ni las 'bras mi rung ste/ /las ni byas ma thag tu 'gag phyir te/ /sa bon gnas med 'bras bu ji ltar myong*/ /'dod pa'i sems las bsam gtan mi 'byung pas/ /'di med sa bon gnas med ji ltar skye/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das lam de dang 'dra/ kha cig kun gzhi rnam shes tshangs pa'am/

/gtso bo 'dod pa rnams dang mtshungs zhes smra/ /gtso bo dbang phyug byed po sems 'di la/ /btags zhes gsungs phyir phyogs mtshungs 'dod pa'ang yin/ /kun tu mtshungs min gtso bo bem po rtag /byed po lus sems gnyis tshogs 'gro ba rtag /'di ni gsal rig mi rtag bag chags can/ /rang gi 'dod pas min phyir khyad par che/ /sa bon kun ldan phyir na 'bras bu ni/ / snang ba thams cad rtag tu 'char 'gyur lo/ /thams cad pa ni rigs la brjod pa ste/ /gzhan tu phan tshun so so'i de ldan 'gyur/ /'di 'bral la sogs khyad par rnams la ni/ /bag chags sa bon logs su yod mi dgos/ /bag chags yod kyang rkyen gyis rim pas 'char/ kha cig rkyen de'ang rtag tu gnas dgos te/ /bag chags kun dang ldan pa yin phyir lo/ /de la rkyen gzhan gnyis pa'ang gnas mod kyi/ /sa bon yod pa kho nas gsal min te/ /rang las skyes pa'i yid byed des gsal 'gyur/ /rkyen sogs rgyu ni rang las byung mod kyang*/ /rkyen ni rtag tu rang la gnas pa min/ /chos kun sems 'di'i mthu las snang mod kyang*/ /de dag 'di dang gcig pa min pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyis smras pa'i skyon 'di gnas pa min/ /don dam dpyod byed rig ngor nged kyang 'gog /rgyu rkyen tshul la khyod kyis lhag brjod yin/ /skya rengs dang po'i dus na'ang sa bon kun/ /yod mod yid byed skyes pas mig gzugs shar/ /de shar bas na gzhan dag sad ma nus/ /de 'og sgra la yid ni gtad pa na/ /snga ma'i nus nyams phyi ma sad par byed/ /snod nang dngos po mi 'dra du ma bcug /gcig phyung thams cad phyung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ /gcig tshig na ni kun kyang tshig 'gyur sogs/ khyod kyi rig pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di la ltos/ /kun gzhi yod de chags sogs 'di dag la/ /dbang yul rnam shes las gzhan shes pa'i rgyu/ /yod de de dag tshogs kyang mi skye ba/ /mthong zhing res 'ga' de las skye mthong phyir/

/nyin re lan re yid la byas pa ni/ /dus gcig lan mang byas pa'i thos pa bas/ /lhag par byang ba la sogs mthong ba'i phyir/ /bag chags rnam par smin pa grub pa yin/ /de bzhin nges shes lan gcig skyes pa yang*/ /rkyen gzhan med kyang gal te mi mthun med/ /yun ring lon na lhag par brtan pa mthong*/ /bag chags rnying pa gso dang gsar ba ni/ /gnyis ka yod la dus mnyam bag chags bgo /de nus skad cig gnyis pa phan chad la'o/ /zhe sdang yod dus sems kyang de'i rnam par/ /'char gyi de yi rjes thogs de ma nges/ /de de'i rnam pa gsal dus mi 'jog par/ /nub dus sa bon 'jog pa ngo mtshar rmad/ /ngo bo bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras snga phyi ste/ khyad par bskyed dang rten la nges pa med/ /rgyu yi 'jog mtshams rnam pa du ma'i phyir/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug gzhung dang 'di mi 'gal/ /gcig car rigs mi mthun skye yang*/ /shin tu gsal ba'i sems gcig gis/ /nus pa nyams par byas pa'i phyir/ /kun gzhi las gzhan 'byung ba min/ /med pa sngar nus med phyir dang*/ /phyis kyang nye bar mi sbyor phyir/ /rgyu rnams thams cad sngar yod yin/ /zhes pa'ang ngo bo skyed byed do/ /gal te nyon mongs can yid med gyur na'ang*/ /'jig ltar mtshungs ldan dge ba mi srid 'gyur/ /snyoms 'jug gnyis la'ang khyad par med 'gyur ro/ /bdag 'dzin rgyun brtan pa yang mi 'thad 'gyur/ /mdo las/ nyon mongs can yid rtag tu ni/ /nyon mongs lhan cig 'byung zhing 'gag /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dag las/ /ma grol mi grol grol mi 'gyur/ /'phags pas bshad pa/ yang dag don la 'jug pa yi/ /sems kyi gegs su rtag 'gyur gang*/ /dus rnams kun tu 'byung ba de/ /ma 'dres pa yi ma rig 'dod/ /de phyir rnam shes brgyad po yod par 'dod/ /bag chags nus pa gnas ngan len zhes pa/ /rnam grangs nyid yin de 'dra rags pa ni/ /nang dang mi gsal ba yi sa bon dang*/

/rgyu dang sa bon skyed byed zhes brjod de/ /mngon par brjod pa'am spros pa'i bag chags ni/ /yid rtog yul la 'phro ba'i sa bon yin/ /'jig lta'am bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags ni/ /bdag 'dzin gyis bgos bdag 'dzin nyid skyed byed/ /las sam srid pa'i yan lag bag chags ni/ /skye 'chi 'byor rgud bde sdug sa bon no/ /nyon mongs :la sogs

(《dzaṃ》 sa bon ) sna tshogs des shes nus/ /bsdu na kun byang sa bon gnyis su 'dus/ /'dzin gnyis bag chags zhes pa'ang gzung 'dzin no/ /yang na rgyu mthun rnam smin bag chags gnyis/ / dge las dge ba skye sogs rgyu mthun te/ /dge las lung ma bstan sogs rnam smin no/ /lung ma bstan dang nyon yid mtshungs ldan dang*/ /zag med dge rnams rgyu mthun kho nar 'dod/ /phyi ma la ni dbang sgyur ma gtogs so/ /'khor ba ji srid 'jug pa'i shes pa dang*/ /'khor dang lam gyi gzhir 'gyur kun gzhi ste/ /ngo bo nang gi gsal rig khyab pa'i dngos/ /rgyu ni bag chags gsar rnying kun 'dus pa/ /'bras bu gnas don lus su snang ba can/ /las ni sa bon gsar rnying thams cad 'dzin/ /rnam 'gyur rnam shes bdun sogs chos kun ldan/ /dmigs pa rang dang 'bras bu kun la dmigs/ /rnam pa thams cad nus pa'i tshul du gnas/ /dbye ba rnam smin sa bon gnyis su 'dod/ /kun gzhi rnam shes bdun gyi bdag po ru/ /dbang pos rnam rig dbang shes rnams kyi ste/ /yid shes la ni nyon yid bdag por 'dod/ /dmigs pa'ang yul lnga chos dang kun gzhi'o/ /gtod byed de ma thag yin rigs 'dra rnams/ /'das ma thag pa'ang der 'dod 'on kyang rgyu/ /rje btsun gyis kyang*/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yis khyad par sems las byung*/ /gcig ni rkyen gyi rnam par shes/ /gnyis pa nye bar spyod pa can/ /nye bar spyod dang yongs spyod dang*/ /de yi 'jug byed sems las byung*/ /rang gi khams la gnyis snang zhing*/ /ma rig nyon mongs lhan cig tu/ /'jug pa'i rnam rtog rab 'byung ste/ /rdzas gnyis rnam par spangs pa yin/ /dmigs pa'i khyad par thob pa ni/ /rang gi dbyings la gnas ldan phyir/ /de nyid gnyis su snang med pa/ /'jug ste pags dang mda' bzhin no/ /sems ni gnyis su snang ba ste/

/de bzhin chags la sogs pa dang*/ /dad la sogs par snang bar 'dod/ /nyon mongs dge chos yod ma yin/ /sems ni sna tshogs snang ba dang*/ /rnam pa sna tshogs can du 'jug /de la snang de yod dang med/ /de phyir chos kyi ma yin no/ /rnam par rtog las las dang sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /las dang sdug bsngal gyis kyang bag chags bskyed/ /dge chos rnam par rtog las mi rtog 'byung*/ /des ni gnyis su snang ba'i sa bon 'joms/ /ma rig rnam rtog las dang sdug bsngal bzlog /yang na gnyis snang bsrabs pas ma rig bzlog /de spangs las dang sdug bsngal bya byed bral/ / 'khor ba 'jug ldog tshul ni de ltar shes/ /nges 'byung mthar thug bdag med gnyis kyi sgo/ /zhes pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad sgrub pa gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// //theg pa chen por chos lnga bstan pa ni/ /sgra dang yid kyi g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /brjod pa'i gnas kyi spyi ni rgyu mtshan te/ /de la bla dwags tshig spyi ming du brjod/ /sems dang sems byung chos rnams rnam rtog yin/ /de bzhin nyid ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /'phags pa'i ye shes kho na'i spyod yul lo/ /yang dag shes pa mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis/ /bag chags snang brnyan sna tshogs mtshan ma dang*/ /kun brtags gang yin rgyu mtshan zhes bya ste/ /rang bzhin dang ni gzugs brnyan rgyu mtshan no/ /rtog dang ma rtog gsal dang mi gsal las/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rgyu mtshan gnyis su 'dod/ /de bzhin chos lnga nyid kyi dbye bas lnga/ /dngos po'i ming dang de bzhin 'brel ba'i ming*/ /bsdus dang tha dad grags dang ma grags te/ /ming gi dbye ba drug tu ma 'dus med/ /rnam par rtog pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas kyang*/ /mtshan las byung dang mtshan med rnam rtog gam/ /nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can min nam/ / yul la 'jug dang tshol ba po dang ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i rnam rtog gsum du 'dus/

/rtog dang shes pa rdzas su yod pa ste/ /ming ni brtags yod rgyu mtshan phal cher yang*/ /de bzhin nyid ni don dam yod pa nyid/ /phyi ma gnyis ni don dam bden pa dang*/ /mthun pa'i don dam tsam du yod pa ste/ /gzhan gsum kun rdzob nyid du yod par grub/ /ming dang rgyu mtshan de nyid gzhan nyid min/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos bzhi'ang brjod du med/ /rnam rtog spyod yul mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan te/ /ming gi tha snyad gnas kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rgyu mtshan yul du byed pa rnam rtog go /phyi ma gnyis kyang yul dang yul can mtshan/ /rgyu mtshan phal dang ming ni kun brtags yin/ /rtog dang shes pa gzhan dbang mtshan nyid can/ /de bzhin nyid ni 'gyur med yongs grub bo/ /rgyu mtshan rnam gzhag bden pa bzhi char la/ /ming ni sdug bsngal bden pa kho nas bsdus/ / 'gog bden ma gtogs gsum gyis rnam rtog dang*/ /rnam par ma gzhag bden bzhis de bzhin nyid/ /kun la dmigs pa'i lam bden yang dag shes/ / gzung 'dzin gnyis gnyis don dam gcig yin te/ /dang po gnyis ni kun rdzob tsam yin la/ /gsum pa kun rdzob bden pa nyid du bshad/ /tha ma gnyis ni don dam dngos rnam grangs/ /chos zhes bya ba don chos go byed do/ /dngos po zhes kyang bya ste mtshan gzhi 'am/ /rten gyi shes bya kun yang lnga po 'di/ /chos lnga zhes ni rab tu brtags pa yin/ /mtshan gzhi kun la mtshan nyid gsum 'jug ste/ /brjod pas brtags pa'i brtags cha kun brtags dang*/ /rang gi rgyu rkyen las skyes rnam rig gzhan/ /gnas lugs gdod mar grub pa yongs grub bo/ /kun tu 'dogs byed yid shes rnam rtog ste/ /gzhan ni bag chags yin te de'i dbang las/ /kun gzhi rnam shes rnam rig bcas par snang*/ /gdod ma'i don ni chos nyid kho na ste/ /'brel ba'i tshul gyis kun la dbye bar 'gyur/ /rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ ji ltar brjod don du shes kyi/

/rgyu mtshan de yi bag chags dang/ /de las kyang don snang ba ni/ /kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ming dang don ni ji lta bar/ /don dang ming du snang ba gang*/ /yang dag min rtog rgyu mtshan ni/ /kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rnam gsum rnam gsum snang ba can/ /'dzin dang gzung ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid do/ /med dang yod nyid gang yin dang*/ /yod dang med pa mnyam nyid dang/ /ma zhi zhi dang rnam mi rtog /yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /brtags pa dang ni gzhan dbang dang*/ /yongs su grub pa nyid kyang ngo*/ /don phy-ir yang dag min rtog phyir/ /gnyis po med pa'i phyir bshad do/ /ngo bo nyid gsum rtag med dang*/ /yod kyang kho na ma yin dang*/ / yod dang med de kho na ste/ /ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /nā gardzu nas kyang*/ phyi yi las dang bya ba rgyu/ /de ni brtags pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de bzhin gzhan dbang nang gi ste/ /rnam shes lnga po 'byung ba'o/ /brtags bya min phyir don dam ni/ /yongs su grub par 'dod pa yin/ /slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa/ /de ni kun tu brtags pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid de de med do/ /gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo ni/ /rnam rtog yin te rkyen las byung*/ /grub ni de la snga ma'o/ /rtag tu med par gyur pa gang*/ /kun brtags de ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ /mtshan nyid chad dang rnam grangs ltos pa'o/ /bdag dang gzung 'dzin shar nub la sogs bzhin/ / 'dogs gzhi kun tu rtog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ /'dogs byed rtog pa'i dbye bar yang 'dod do/ /ngo bo nyid dang khyad par kun brtags gnyis/ /'dogs byed dbye bas mtha' yas dbye bar 'gyur/ /sa bon gzhan dbang kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ /kun byang ngo bor ma grub gzhan dbang ngo*/ /yang na ma dag dag pa'i 'jig rten gnyis/

/lang gshegs mdo las tshogs drug dbye ba gsungs// rnam rig bcu gcig 'di yi dbye bar gyur*/ /'phags pas gsungs pa/ dag pa de ni rang bzhin dang*/ /dri ma med dang lam dang dmigs/ /rnam par dag pa chos kyi rnams/ /rnam pa bzhi pos bsdus pa yin/ /rje btsun gyis kyang/ 'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa/ /yongs su grub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /dang po gnyis ni gang la der song ba'i/ /skyes bu'i ldog chas phye yi ngo bo gcig /phyi ma gnyis ni rjes mthun yin par 'dod/ /gzhan dbang nyid na'ang de yi gnyen por 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid gsum po de nyid gzhan nyid min/ /kun brtags btags cha gzhan dbang 'dog yul nyid/ /yongs su grub pa de de'i chos nyid yin/ / chos can chos nyid tshul du gnas pa dang*/ /yod dang med pas gcig pa bkag pa'i phyir/ /gnyis dang yongs grub gcig dang tha dad min/ /rnam par dpyad na gzhan dbang kun brtags su/ /'dus phyir mtshan nyid gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan dbang gi ni snang cha kun brtags te/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba bgrang yas bsam mi khyab/ /snang gzhi'i sems kyang sa bon thams cad pa/ /de de'i chos nyid du song de yang de'o/ /kun brtags med phyir gzung 'dzin spros dang bral/ /yongs grub dgu dang stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ rang bzhin yongs grub rnam dag yongs grub ni/ /'gog dang lam gyi dbye bas rab tu bzhag /re zhig gzhan dbang snang cha ma bral ba/ /de srid de yin de zhig de yang zhig /shel gyi sngon po bcom pas shel zhig ltar/ /de tshe chos nyid 'ba' zhig lus par zad/ /don la snang cha las gzhan snang ba med/ /gzhan dbang la ni rang ngo'i tshugs thub bral/ /de yi rang bzhin tshul du yongs grub gnas/ /rnam pa gang yin kun brtags tshul yin no/ /mdo las kyang*/ gang brtags pa yi dngos po 'di/ /gzhan gyi dbang yang de nyid de/ /brtags pa sna tshogs snang ba ni/ / gzhan gyi dbang zhes rtogs par byed/

rje btsun gyis bshad pa/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis ni med dang yod pa dang*/ /sgro 'dogs skur ba'i rtog dang gcig dang du ma nyid/ /rang dang khyad par rtogs dang ming don ji bzhin du/ /mngon par zhen pa'i rtog pa yang dag spang bar bya/ /de bcu rnam g.yeng rnam par rtog pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i rnam rtog kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /mtshan ma mtshan snang gzung bya 'dzin byed rig /mtshan 'gyur phan gnod rga sogs bde sdug sogs/ /de gnyis bsdoms pas snang 'gyur rnam rtog yin/ /tshul min rnam rtog chos min thos las te/ /tshul bzhin legs gsung chos thos rjes su 'gro/ /gnyis ka'ang gzhan bstan rnam par rtog pa yin/ /mngon zhes rnam rtog lta ba'i 'thibs po'o/ /lus dang lus can rnam rig dbang po lnga/ /za po yid dang nyer spyod yul drug dang*/ /nyer spyod 'jug shes de nas dus dang grangs/ /grong sogs yul dang tha snyad rnam rig ni/ /mngon par brjod pa'i bag chags las byung zhing*/ / bdag gzhan snang ba'i rnam rig bdag lta las/ /mtho ris ngan 'gro 'chi 'pho skye ba yi/ /rnam rig srid pa'i yan lag sa bon las/ /byung phyir thams cad rnam par rig pa nyid/ /rnam rig tsam ni snang zhing myong bas grub/ /de phyir kun rdzob bden pa'i tshul la gnas/ /ji ltar dwangs pa chu mtshor nyi zla sogs/ /gzugs brnyan rnam pa du ma shar gyur na/ /de dang chu la dbye ba med mod kyi/ /chu ni yod la gzugs brnyan med snang bzhin/ /gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs kun tu brtags pa'i chos/ /rnam shes tsam ni chu dang mtshungs pa ste/ /kun rdzob bden pa nyid kyi dbang du byas/ /dam pa'i don du de dag gang yang med/ /bum par snang ba'i dus na bum pa'i cha/ /kun brtags nyid yin shes pa snang ba tsam/ /gzhan gyi dbang ste de gnyis 'khrul ba yin/ /de de'i shul gyi ye shes yongs grub bo/ /chags sdang snang cha de yi rig pa dang*/ /de yi ro mnyam spros bral gsum po de/

/lam nyid gzhan dbang de yi rtogs pa dang*/ /chos nyid dmigs pa gzhan gnyis yin par shes/ /sgra rtog snang ba'i chos sku'ang kun brtags te/ /de yi rnam pa 'dzin pa'i sems gzhan dbang*/ /de 'dra dngos ni yongs su grub pa ste/ /rig 'di shes bya kun la sbyar bar bya/ /'on kyang tshig la 'chel ba yis/ /thob pa thug med smra ba ltar/ /ha cang thal ba'i rnam bzhag spangs/ /de phyir mtshan gzhi kun la sbyor/ /rje btsun gyis kyang*/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing*/ /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang*/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /'phags pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ ji ltar snang ba de ltar med/ /de phyir med ces brjod par mdzad/ /gang phyir de ltar snang gyur pa/ /de phyir yod ces brjod par mdzad/ /rang dang bdag nyid med pa'i phyir/ /rang gi dngos la mi gnas phyir/ /gzung ba bzhin du de med phyir/ /ngo bo nyid med nyid du bzhed/ /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /brten nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin med par bstan pa yin/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang rten 'brel nyid du brjod/ /de ni gnyis te bskyed bya skyed byed dang*/ / gzhag bya 'jog byed dbang byas rten 'byung ngo*/ /dang po gzhan dbang gnyis pa kun brtags yin/ /rten 'brel don ni phrad <pra ti pa > nas 'byung <sa mut+pata ba > ste/ /tshogs la ltos nas bzhag gam byung zhes pa'o/ /yang na snga ma la brten phyi mar 'brel/ /'di ni bskyed pa'i bya byed kho na'i ste/ /ngo bo nyid rnams 'byed pa'i rten 'brel ni/ /chos kun kun gzhi rnam shes las sprul pa'o/ /sdug mi sdug rnams 'byed pa bcu gnyis te/ /nyer spyod can ni tshogs drug 'jug tshul lo/ /rnam shes 'byung dang 'chi 'pho skye ba dang*/ /lo tog la sogs phyi yi rab dbye dang*/ /'jig 'chags la sogs snod kyi rten 'brel dang*/

/zas bzhis 'tsho dang 'gro ba rnam gnyis su/ /las kyi 'khrid pa 'dod dang mi 'dod 'gro/ / rnam dag rab dbye lam lngas thar ba sgrub/ /mthu stobs rab dbye mngon shes la sogs te/ /brgyad po 'di yang 'brel ba can rten 'brel/ /'chi 'pho skye ba yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /de la'ang skad cig pa dang 'brel ba can/ /gnas skabs pa'am rgyun chags gsum du 'dod/ /gnas skabs pa yang skye ba gnyis dang gsum/ /rten 'brel tshar re rdzogs tshul so so ste/ /'phen 'grub bzhi ldan rgyu 'bras tshar gcig po/ /skye ba gnyis yin gzhan dang 'di mi bsre/ /sa bon 'debs dang gso ba rtogs phyir gsungs/ /tshe gsum la rdzogs rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis so/ /'phen 'grub dbye ba med par bsres pa ste/ /rmongs pa rnam gsum bzlog phyir 'di yang gsungs/ /tshe gcig la yang rdzogs pa yod pa ste/ /go rim dkrug na yan lag rdzogs pa 'gal/ /skad cig pa ni skad cig gcig la tshang*/ /'brel ba can yang de 'dra'i rgyun du bzhed/ /yang na yan lag re re skad cig pa/ /rim gyis mthud par bshad kyang rung bar mngon/ /rje btsun gyis kyang gsungs pa/ bsgribs pa'i phyir dang 'debs pa'i phyir/ /khrid pa'i phyir dang kun 'dzin phyir/ /rdzogs byed phyir dang gsum gcod phyir/ /nye bar spyod phyir bsdud pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba'i phyir dang mngon du'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal phyir ni 'gro nyon mongs/ /rnam gsum rnam gnyis kyang nyon mongs/ /rnam bdun yang dag min rtog las/ /slob dpon gyis kyang bshad pa/ gang gis 'phen dang ji ltar gang*/ /de sgrub byed pa'ang de la yang*/ /nyes dmigs gang yin de dag rnams/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnams kyis bstan/ /yan lag gnyis kyis gcig gis dang*/ /rnam pa bzhi dang gnyis kyis dang*/ /gcig gis gcig gis gcig gis ni/ /don bdun dag tu rab tu bstan/ /bden pa ji bzhin mi shes phyir/ /las kyis sems la bgo phyir dang*/

/yan lag bzhi ni rim gyis 'phen/ /de yi sa bon yongs brtas phyir/ /'phangs pa bzhin du skyes pa yi/ /tshor bas bskyed pa'i sred pa las/ /len pa byung bas de yi las/ /bgos pa mngon du gyur pa yin/ /grub pa skye yin de la yang*/ /rgas sogs nyes dmigs gang g-i phyir/ /bden pa mthong la 'phen pa med/ /sred dang bral na 'byung ba med/ /de la rgyu rkyen dbye ba mdor bsdus tsam/ /shes na rten 'brel don la nges rnyed 'gyur/ /ci phyir g.yo med mi rtag mthu ldan las/ /dngos po rnams kyi skye 'gags byed phyir ro/ /byed po'i blo dang gtso sogs rtag pa dang*/ /dus sogs mthu med mi mthun rgyu spangs phyir/ /rgyal bas rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i dbye ba dang*/ /rten 'brel rnam pa du ma rab tu gsungs/ /rten 'brel thams cad bcos ma glo bur ba/ /du ba'i rnam rig mer shes las skyes dang*/ / nyon mongs snang bas las kyi rnam rig bskyed/ de las skyes pa'i rnam rig 'byung ba yin/ /rdul gyi rnam rig las ni rags snang skye/ /dbang bo'i rnam rig gzugs kyi rnam rig dang*/ /yid kyi g.yo las rnam shes 'char ba sogs/ /skye ba'i rnam rig de las skyes rnam rig /gnas pa'i rnam rig de las 'gag rnam rig /de las 'gags zin par snang rnam rig ste/ /dus gsum rnam par snang yang bden dngos med/ /bag chags gcig gsos de las snang ba 'byung*/ / snang ba des kyang bag chags gcig shos gso/ sa bon gso dang rnam rig rnam pa gnyis/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs te/ /gso dang rnam rig rgyun dang rgyun du 'byung*/ /'di dag kun rdzob gnas thabs mthar thug yin/ /rnam rig de yang rmi lam shes pa bzhin/ /gdod nas yod ma myong yang snang mi 'gag /rmi lam me las tshig par snang ba bzhin/ /yod med rtag chad kun las 'das pa yin/ /de ni don dam pa la 'jug tshul gyi/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i rim pa gcig tu 'dod/

/don dam la ni rten 'brel nam yang med/ /de la rgyu 'bras dang ni rnam gzhag bral/ /rten 'brel yin phyir bdag med rnam rig phyir/ /chos bdag med la rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /phung po'i rgyun dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes la/ /bdag dang sems can chos su 'khrul ba skyes/ /rten 'brel de dag kun rdzob rten 'brel te/ /de de'i rnam rig bdag med don dam 'jug /de 'dra'i chos dbyings de de'i snang brnyan can/ /de ni don dam kho na'i rten 'brel lo/ /de 'dra rten cing 'byung ba'i chos nyid de/ /don dam rten 'brel de ni rten 'byung min/ /gang las kyang ni ma byung ma ltos la/ /mi 'gyur spros bral rtag pa yin phyir ro/ /rgyu drug rkyen bzhi 'bras bu lnga zhes grags/ /byed rgyu ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu yin te/ /lhan cig 'byung ba grogs te mthun par rtogs/ / mtshungs ldan rgyu ste rgyas pa skal mnyam yin/ /kun 'gro bar gcod rnam smin yongs 'dzin no/ /mtshungs ldan sems dang sems byung rgyu dmigs dang*/ /yul dang rnam pa gcig pa de yin pas/ /dgos pa'i dbang yin lhan cig 'byung bar 'dus/ /'di la phyi nang gnyis yod mtshan nyid dang*/ /mtshan gzhi sems dang sems byung 'byung sogs bzhin/ /de yang sa rdul skad cig dang po de/ /chu me rlung gsum gnyis pa'i lhan cig rgyu/ /de bzhin phan tshun re rer sbyar bar bya/ /'on kyang dngos 'bras dngos rgyu thogs med nus/ /dus mnyam 'byung bar snang ba'ang de yin no/ /kun 'gro nyon mongs las ni nyon mongs skye/ /nang tshan rigs dang sa sogs ma nges pa/ /'di yang skal mnyam khongs su phal cher 'du/ /de ni mthun pa'i rgyu ste dge sogs dge /sa mtshungs la sogs mtshungs pa bskyed par 'dod/ /mi mthun dge mi dge las lung ma bstan/ /skye 'gyur de ni rnam par smin pa'i rgyu/ /byed rgyu nus med 'thad pa ma yin pas/ /byed par bcas pa byed pa'i rgyu yin no/

/'bras bu 'byung dang 'tsho dang rten dang gnas/ /'gyur dang 'bral dang bzo dang gtan tshigs dang*/ /'bras thob 'phen dang 'grub dang bar chad byed/ /rnying par byed dang 'jig par byed pa dang*/ /nges par byed dang ma nges byed la sogs/ /mdor na rgyu kun byed pa'i rgyu yin yang*/ /skyes bus byed pa logs su sngar las dbye/ /kun gyi rgyu rkyen kun gzhirnam shes te/ /lhan cig 'byung sogs rgyu lnga rgyu ru 'dod/ /nyer len rgyu ni nges par 'dir 'thad do/ /lhag ma rnams ni lhan cig byed rkyen yin/ /dmigs rkyen mthong dang dmigs pa'i yul yin te/ /bdag po zhes bya rten te byed rgyur 'dus/ /de ma thag rkyen rang mtshungs rgyur gcig pa'i/ /'das ma thag 'dod 'di dang dmigs pa'i rkyen/ /'dzin chos la yin gzhan la rkyen gnyis so/ /de ma thag pa go 'byed las can nam/ /yang na yul la phyogs par byed 'dod de/ /snga ma ltar na gzugs sogs la yod 'gyur/ /'dzin cha kun la'ang rkyen bzhir ma nges te/ /srid pa'i dbang byas bral 'bras bskyed rgyu med/ /brtags 'gog bral 'bras dngos yin kun rdzob ste/ /don dam bral ba dngos te 'bras bu brtags/ /bdag 'bras yul dang rnam smin rgyud kyis bsdus/ /byed rgyu'i sgo nas byung gang byed 'bras te/ /skal mnyam 'bras bu rgyu mthun zhes bya'o/ /gtso bor brjod kyis mtha' gcig kho nar min/ /rgyu rnams thams cad nges par gnyis su 'dus/ /rgyu las byung na de la ltos par 'gyur/ /ltos pa thams cad rang gi ngo bos med/ /rnam gzhag phan tshun ltos pas rnam gzhag 'jig /de tsam kho nas ngo bo ltos mi 'grub/ /ri gnyis phan tshun ltos pa med pa bzhin/ / g.yas kyi 'jog byed g.yon pa yin zhes pa/ /g.yas kyi rnam gzhag g.yon gyi rnam gzhag la/ /ltos par song gi dngos po ltos pa min/ /de phyir rten 'brel gtso bo bskyed par brjod/ /ces pa chos lnga dang rang bzhin gsum dang rten 'brel gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga pa'o//

//phyin log gzhan gsum bdag lta'i grogs yin te/ /bdag ni rtag tu'am re zhig gnas 'dod rtag /sngar gnas bden las gzhan du chad snyam pa/ /gang zag la ltos rtag chad mthar lta 'o/ /'dus byas nam yang rtag pa'i go skabs med/ /mi rtag pa las med dang sdug bsngal rtogs/ /sdug bsngal can ni byed por mi rung zhing*/ /mi rtag pa la bdag dang byed po 'gal/ /de ltar yang rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ mi rung rgyu las skyes phyir dang*/ /'gal phyir rang nyid mi gnas phyir/ /med phyir mtshan nyid nges phyir dang*/ /rjes su 'jug phyir 'gag pa'i phyir/ /yongs su 'gyur bar dmigs phyir dang*/ /de rgyu nyid dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /zin pa'i phyir dang bdag po'i phyir/ /dag dang sems can rjes 'jug phyir/ /dang po je bas je che dang*/ /rgyas dang rten gyi dngos po dang*/ /'gyur dang yongs su smin pa dang*/ /de bzhin dman dang khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /yul gzhan 'gro dang sa bon bcas/ /sa bon med pa'i ngo bo dang*/ /gzugs brnyan du ni skye ba ste/ /skye ba rnam pa bcu bzhi la/ /rgyu dang tshad kyi khyad par dang*/ /rgyas pa don med mi rung dang*/ /rten nyid du ni mi srid dang*/ /gnas pa la ni mi srid dang*/ /dang po mi 'jig mthar mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin dman dang khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /'gro med gnas pa mi rung dang*/ /tha ma nyid ni mi srid dang*/ /sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /'byung ba rnams dang don rnam drug /skad cig nyid du brjod pa ni/ /skam dang 'phel dang rang bzhin gyi/ /g.yo dang 'phel dang 'grib pa'i phyir/ /'byung ba de dang 'brel phyir dang*/ /yongs su 'gyur ba gzhi yi phyir/ kha dog dri dang ro dang reg /'dra phyir de ni de dang 'dra/ /bud shing rags las byung ba'i phyir/ /jai bas je cher dmigs pa'i phyir/

/sems rjes 'jug phyir dri ba'i phyir/ /des na phyi yang skad cig ma/ /smras pa/ gang zhig gang na'ang yod min pa/ /rtag ces bya ba mi 'thad do/ /nam mkha' dang ni rigs spyi sogs/ /mkhas pas bshad kyang rtsod pa'i ngor/ /'gyur dngos gcod dang grags phyir yin/ /de rnams brtags yod nyid yin phyir/ /blo yis brtags pa kho nar zad*/ /'di dag 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /rtag pa ci ste min snyam na/ /'di la khyad gzhi ma grub pas/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'gyur med min/ /gzhi med pa la skye 'gag sogs/ /yod med gang yang mi 'thad do/ /mo gsham bu la skye ba ni/ /med ces bzhin te skye med min/ /chos dbyings ci yang ma yin pa/ /gnas lugs don dam zhes smra ste/ /de 'dra 'dod pa'i skye med ni/ /don dam min te 'di dang mtshungs/ /yod cing grub la skye ba ni/ /med na skye med ces brjod bya/ /ye nas grub na skye ba med/ /'byung min gnas dang 'gag pa med/ /skye 'jig can la rdzas yod dang*/ /brtags yod gnyis su 'dod pa yin/ /gnas pa la ni rdzas dang btags/ /don dam zhes bya dbye ba gsum/ /'on kyang byung rjes gnas na gnas/ /gdod mar gnas la gnas pa med/ /'gog pa gnyis kyang byas par 'gyur/ /'di dag gsar ba skyes phyir ro/ /skyes la mi 'gag med pas na/ /skye 'jig can te 'dus byas yin/ /'gog pa skad cig gcig dang gnyis/ /bskal par lon sogs yod pa ste/ /thob pa po dang de 'brel phyir/ /dus kyi 'khrid pas 'gyur ba nyid/ /byung yang skyes pa min snyam na/ /gzugs sogs la yang thal bar 'gyur/ /skyes kyang mi 'jig srid snyam na/ /dngos po rtag pa yod par 'gyur/ / dngos med yin yang gsar ba skye/ /de yang rgyu can nyid 'gyur ro/ /de lta na ni dngos po dang*/ /khyad par med par 'gyur snyam na/ /chos can gang la nyer len nam/ /rdzas med mtshan gzhi'i dngos med de/ /ltos ngor 'dus byas mtshan nyid can/

/brtags pa tsam yang sel ngor skye/ /de la rdzas su skye ba med/ /kun rdzob bden par 'di mi skye/ /rdzas su skye 'jig yod pa ni/ /dngos po 'dus byas rnams la yin/ /rig dang snang ngor de dag la/ /skye 'jig 'gyur ba gang las 'grub/ /brtags pa 'khrul ba'i ngor byas na/ /dngos med rgyu dang bcas par 'dod/ /skye 'jig yod kyang 'dus byas ni/ /min na ha cang thal 'gyur te/ / 'dus byas rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ /ldan yang min zhes su zhig smra/ /rdzas med la ni nyer len dang*/ /lhan cig byed pa med mod kyang*/ /nyams par byed dang byed rgyu yod/ /bral ba'i rgyu yod kha cig la'o/ /'jog dang byed las rdzas mi skye/ /brtags pa'i ngor ni nges bskyed pas/ /ri bong rwa sogs blo ngo na'ang*/ /mi srid pa dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /'di rtag rdzas su rtag na ni/ /rtag pa'i dngos 'gyur mtshan nyid 'gal/ /'on te brtags par rtag na ni/ /blo ngor skye 'jig byed dang 'gal/ /gang zhig rnam par shes pa dang*/ /rtaug yul thams cad 'dus byas dang*/ /ye shes kho na'i rang spyod yul/ /'dus ma byas pa don dam nyid/ /blo ngo'i chos las grol ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ni 'phros don gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /mi rtag phyir na gnas pa'i go skabs med/ /gnas pa'i rang dbang med phyir sdug bsngal nyid/ /lam yang sdug kun rigs kyi khongs su 'dus/ / phun tshogs 'jig dang mi bsrun phrad pa dang*/ /rgyu las 'bras bur 'gyur te de yang 'jig /dri ma nus dang bag chags med las 'dzin/ /de las 'bras 'gyur de yang 'jig pas skrag /sdug bsngal thams cad mi rtag rgyu mtshan can/ /byed po rtag dang dbang sgyur yin 'dod na/ /sdug bsngal can phyir mi 'dod bab min nam/ /'bras tshe rang 'jig rtag min rang dbang med/ /bya byed las kyi byed po 'dod mod kyi/ /rtag dbang gcig pus dngos po gcig la yang*/ /byed mi nus na thams cad smos ci dgos/

/byed po rtag na rim pas 'byung ba 'gal/ / 'dod pas rim par bskyed na gcig pus 'gal/ /dbang phyug 'dod par gcig na du mar 'gyur/ /'dod pa byed por gcig na de yang brtag /tha dad rgyu 'bras yin na mi rtag nyid/ /rgyu mang gzhan yang yod na rten 'brel mtshungs/ /rtag pa'i rgyu 'bras yin na rim pa 'gal/ /'brel ba gnyis dang bral na byed pos min/ /de phyir bdag ni byed po'i bya ba 'dor/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin spong 'dod bdag len 'dod/ /mi rtag dus kyis 'khrid la bdag dbang med/ /chu thigs du ma'ang so so'i sar skams na/ /chu bor mi 'gyur mi rtag du ma la/ /bdag bya'i mtshan nyid nam yang yod ma yin/ /bdag po rang dbang rtag pa med/ /de las bde sdug sbyin bya'i yul/ /bdag kyang med par rtogs pa na/ khams gsum pa yi nyon mongs zlog /gang zag bdag med sgom pa yod med las/ /srid las grol ba yod med rjes su dpog /ma rig pa las 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /de las 'dod chags zhe sdang shugs drag 'byung*/ / bdag lta med na nyon mongs gzhan yod kyang*/ /yang srid 'phen byed las ni gsog mi nus/ /ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang*/ /de nyid gzhan la spos nas byed por 'dzin/ /de yi khyad par rtag gcig rang dbang can/ /rang bzhin gtsang bzang ma 'dres pa ru blta/ /blo dman rnams la dang por rig pa brtan/ /chos nyid dang yang rjes mthun yin par 'dod/ /dpal gyi mgur nas kyang*/ phung po rnams la bdag med de/ /phung po rnams kyang bdag la med/ /rnam rtog bzhin du de dag med/ /de dag med pa'ang ma yin no/ /rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ bdag dang byed po 'gog pa yang 'di ltar/ / bdag tu lta ba'i bdag nyid bdag mtshan min/ /ngan par gnas min mtshan nyid mi 'dra'i phyir/ /gnyis las gzhan med de ni nor ba skyes/ /de phyir thar ba nor tsam zad pa yin/ /ji ltar 'khrul ba tsam brten skye bo yis/

/sdug bsngal rang bzhin rgyun chags rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rig min rig nyid sdug bsngal sdug bsngal med/ /chos kyi rang bzhin de yi rang bzhin min/ /brten nas dngos rab skye ba mngon 'jug na/ /skye bo ji ltar gzhan gyi byas la brten/ /gang phyir yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba/ /'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa 'di gang zhig /gang zag rdzas su yod ma yin/ /brtags par yod pa nyid du brjod/ /mi dmigs phyin ci log pa dang*/ /kun nas nyon mongs nyon mongs rgyu/ /nyes pa gnyis phyir de las 'di/ /gcig dang gzhan du brjod bya min/ /phung po bdag tu thal ba dang*/ /de rdzas nyid du thal 'gyur phyir/ /mtshan nyid dang ni 'jig rten na/ / mthong phyir bstan bcos sgo nas kyang*/ /bud shing me bzhin gnyis su ni/ / brjod min mi rung dmigs phyir ro/ /gnyis yod rnam shes skye ba'i phyir/ /de rkyen ma yin don med phyir/ /de phyir lta ba po nas ni/ /grol ba'i bar du mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag po nyid gcig yin na ni/ /mi rtag mi 'dod 'byung mi byed/ / de las mtshan nyid sgrub dgos te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gsum la gnod/ / nyes pa gsum phyir lta sogs la/ /de yi byed par rang byung min/ /byed pa de yi rkyen can yang*/ /lta sogs byed pa med pa yin/ /byed po min phyir mi rtag phyir/ /gcig char rtag tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ /lta la sogs pa byed pa ni/ /rang byung nyid du mi rung ngo*/ /de bzhin gnas dang zhig pa ni/ /snga na med dang mi rtag dang*/ /phyogs gsum pa yang med pa'i phyir/ /rkyen nyid du ni mi rung ngo*/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang ba'i/ /gnas skabs gcod pa'i bye brag dang*/ /'jug dang rgyun gyi bye brag kyang*/ /gang zag gis ni nye bar bstan/ /gang zag yod na thams cad ni/ /'bad med thar pa'am thar ba med/ /gcig dang rgyu dang za ba dang*/ /byed pa dang ni dbang bsgyur dang*/ /bdag po'i don dang rtag pa dang*/

/ nyon mongs pa dang dag pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor can dang ma grol grol/ /'di dag la ni bdag tu lta/ /gnyen por mkhas pa bcu gsungs so/ /bdag 'dzin 'di yi dmigs pa rang rgyud kyi/ /phung po lnga yin rnam pa bdag tu lta/ /'khrul phyir rnam rtog gting tshugs ma yin pas/ /gzhan gyi rgyud dang rgyud mi gtogs pa la'ang*/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'du shes skye ba srid/ /phung po ris gcig res 'ga' lnga la sogs/ /nges med tshul gyis 'jug pa'ang mthong ba yin/ /bdag gir 'dzin pa'ang 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /gtso bor rnam shes las gzhan rang gzhan rgyud/ /yo byad sogs la 'jug mod nges pa med/ /de de'i 'dzin stangs zhes yul dngos mi srid/ /ma dpyad 'jig rten ngor bstun gang zag 'dod/ / dngos po'i don du nam yang yod ma yin/ /yang dag kun rdzob tsam du brtags yod nyid/ /mthong po sems can sogs kyang de dang mthun/ /dngos dang don du yod par de 'dod 'khrul/ /log par rig pas ma rig khyad par can/ /ma rig du ma rjes su 'brel ba'i phyir/ /blo chen 'gas kyang ma rig tha snyad sbyar/ /nyon mongs gsum du bsdu bar sngar bshad zin/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ gal te phung bo bdag yin na/ /skye dang 'jig pa can du 'gyur/ /gal te phung po rnams las gzhan/ /phung po'i mtshan nyid med par 'gyur/ /gal te lha de mi de na/ /de lta na ni rtag par 'gyur/ /gal te lha las mi gzhan na/ /de lta na ni mi rtag 'gyur/ / nye bar len nyid bdag ma yin/ /de dag 'byung dang 'jig pa yin/ nye bar blangs pa ji lta bur/ /nye bar len po yin par 'gyur/ /

(《dzaṃ》+ bdag ni nye bar len pa las/ /gzhan du 'thad pa nyid ma yin/ / ) skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan don skyes bu gang*/ /brgya pa las kyang*/ gal te nang bdag bud med min/ /skyes min ma ning ma yin pa/ /de tshe mi shes 'ba' zhig las/ /khyod bdag pho 'o rnyam du sems/ /skyes pa bdag min mo gzugs mi 'dra'i phyir/ /bud med ma ning la yang de 'drar shes/ /mtshan nyid 'gal la dngos po gcig pa ci/ /'dod ldan bdag na chags bral der mi 'gyur/ /bcing ba bdag 'dod na ni grol ba min/ /mtshan nyid 'gal yang yin na sa sogs kyang*/ /bdag tu ha cang thal ba ma yin nam/ /de kho na nyid yin na sna tshogs 'gal/ /tshor bas myong phyir myong bo bdag yod min/ /de bdag yin na len po lag pa dang*/ /'gro bo rkang yin de ni len 'gro med/ /las ni lus ngag sems pas byed mthong phyir/ /bdag gis ma byas ci phyir 'bras bu myong*/ /cha shas las gzhan tshogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /lus ngag sems ni nam yang bdag ma yin/ /thams cad yin na gzhan dbang mi rtag 'khrul/ /du mar 'gyur phyir bdag ni yod ma yin/ /khyab pa'i tshul la khyab byar gcig yin na/ /sngar bshad skyon dang khyab byar mi gcig na/ /bde sdug bdag gis myong ba med par 'gyur/ /dge sdug sogs dang ma 'brel las 'bras dang*/ /bcings grol sogs kyang de la med par 'gyur/ /mchod sbyin bdag na yon tan bshes gnyen yang*/ /bdag gi 'du shes mchod sbyin la 'jug 'gyur/ /ri bo'i 'du shes bye brag med pa bzhin/ /sde snod kyi tshul las kyang*/ bdag ces bya ba bdud kyi sems/ khyod ni lta bar gyur pa yin/ /'du byed phung po 'dis stong ste/ /'di la sems can yod ma yin/ /ji ltar yan lag tshogs rnams la/ / brten nas shing rtar brjod pa ltar/ /de bzhin phung po rnams brten nas/ /kun rdzob sems can zhes bya'o/

/mchog gzhan don du gnyer phyir dang*/ /skye 'jig blo can nyid kyi phyir/ /skye bos 'di yi dbang sogs las/ /bdag ni tha dad gyur par shes/ /lus bdag yin na so sor phye ba dang*/ /sems bdag yin na'ang sems dang sems byung dbye/ /gnyis ka las gzhan yin na phyi nang tshol/ / tshogs spyi tsam zhig yin na rdzas su med/ /bdag la lus ldan mi rung mtshan nyid dang*/ /rgyu 'bras rten dang brten pa bdag po'i 'brel/ /gang yang 'thad pa ma yin skyon bcas phyir/ /mtshan nyid sngar bkag phan tshun bskyed pa min/ /bskyed na mi rtag de bzhin gzhan ltos 'gyur/ /lus rten yin na bdag ni skye dang 'jig /bdag rten yin na lus ni rtag par thal/ /bdag lus phan tshun yod 'dod bdag po'i 'brel/ /gzugs la bdag ni phyi nang kun ma dmigs/ / bdag la gzugs gnas na ni 'bral ba 'gal/ /bdag gis bdag byas gzugs sogs 'dir len dbang*/ /dgos na de ltar min no gzugs min phyir/ /bla 'og sogs dang gnas gcig rung ma yin/ /rtswa shing sa la brten ltar ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'phel 'grib byed sogs ma dmigs phyir/ /byed kyang ma nges phyi rol la yod phyir/ /lus sems spyi bo bdag na'ang mi rung ste/ /gzugs sems gcig yin cig shos 'gal phyir ro/ /de ltar gang zag bdag med ni/ /theg pa che chung kun la yod/ /theg chen thun mong min lam du/ /bsgom bya chos kyi bdag med do/ /chos kyi bdag 'dzin dngos por zhen pa dang*/ /bden 'dzin dngos 'dzin ming gi rnam grangs so/ /med 'dzin tha snyad 'dzin pa tsam yin te/ /med la 'dzin rgyu med pas yod par 'dus/ /'dus byas ngo bos yod na chos bdag brjod/ /dang po gnyis pa'i dus gnas rtag pa'i ste/ /sngar ni bden yod 'gag pa chad par 'dod/ /bden min snang ba tsam la rtag chad med/ /gnas lugs sems dus kun rdzob yod lta rtag /don dam med par lta na chad pa'i mtha'/ /rnam par mi rtog la 'jug gegs kyi skabs/

/yod sogs sgrub rtog rtag dang dgag rtog chad/ /dgag sgrub thams cad don dam tshul la med/ /de kun chos kyi bdag 'dzin khongs su 'dus/ /don du 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa kun/ /de yi phyogs mthun nyid du shes par bya/ /dbye na zhen pa'i rtog dang mi rtog gnyis/ /gnyis pa'ang zhen par 'brel dang ma 'brel gnyis/ /sa thob zhen med g.yo dang mi g.yo ste/ /de ni dag pa'i sa na yod pa yin/ /zhen rtog de yang ngo bo nyid rtog dang*/ khyad par dang ni bsdus dang dbye bar 'dod/ /mdor na gnas tshul la ni chos yod 'dzin/ /bden par snang phyin de la 'dzin zhes bya/ /chos rtog mi g.yo snang yang bden snang med/ /snang ba'ang snga ma'i mthu yin de phyir te/ /chos bdag 'dzin pa'i cha shas bsgos par 'dod/ /de phyir 'di spangs rdzogs na sangs rgyas nyid/ /bden par ma yin sgyu mar 'dzin pa yang*/ /re zhig mi dgag spyir ni chos bdag lta/ /don dam bden 'dzin mnyam gzhag dus na spangs/ /gzhan du ma yin gnas tshul la zhugs phyir/ /kun rdzob bden par 'dzin pa nyon mongs dpung*/ /'di ni der 'gal dad sogs bskyed cing 'phel/ /ye shes bden grub chos kyi bdag ma yin/ /de ni med par 'dzin na log lta nyid/ /da ni rigs pa cung zad bshad bya ste/ /spyi rnams dngos po gzhan la ma 'brel zhing*/ /gang la rten dngos dang yang ma 'brel la/ /me spyis me yi don byed bsreg pa'am/ /de rgyu de 'bras khyad par la phan na/ /don nus yin yang de la med pas na/ /don byed nus min myong min gnas med pa/ /brtag pa las gzhan ma mthong de phyir med/ /gser bum la gnas bum chos gzhan mi 'gro/ /dngul sogs gzhan gyi bum chos de la min/ /re rer rang rang las gzhan spyi bum med/ /log na'ang spyi ni grub pa med phyir med/ /ming gi snga rol ming gi blo med pas/ /don med 'gyur las don ni sngar yod dang*/ /ming mang bzhin du don yang mang 'gyur dang*/

/gcig 'jug gzhan mi 'jug pa'i rgyu med dang*/ /ming gcig phyir na don mang gcig tu 'gyur/ /sngar med na ni gzugs sogs mthong min 'gyur/ /ma brtags gong du'ang ming blor thal 'gyur bas/ /ming don 'brel med brjod du med pa yin/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis bshad pa/ lag sogs g.yo na thams cad dag /g.yo bar 'gyur phyir 'gal ba can/ /las ni gcig tu mi rung phyir/ /gzhan du tha dad grub par 'gyur/ /gcig bsgribs pa na thams cad dag /sgrib par 'gyur ba'am ma bsgrib na/ /mthong 'gyur gcig tshon gyis bsgyur na/ /bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur rtogs par 'gyur/ /de phyir tshogs pa gcig yod min/ /zhi ba lhas kyang*/ rgyud dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ /'phreng ba dmag la sogs bzhin brdzun/ /'das pa'i dngos yod na ni yang skyed dang*/ /slar yang 'jig 'gyur ma 'ongs dngos yod na/ /de ni rang rgyu sngon song yin par 'gyur/ /slar yang 'bras 'byin da lta'ang 'bras 'byin nam/ /'das pa rgyu na mes tshig sa bon las/ /myu gur thal 'gyur ma 'ongs 'bras yin na/ /byung dang skyais par thal te de dag med/ /snang du rung yang dmigs pa min phyir ro/ /gzugs 'das yod na gzugs sam gzugs min yod/ /gzugs na mthong 'gyur gzhan na srid min no/ /de phyir spyi dang rags pa rgyun dag dang*/ /ming don 'brel dang dus gnyis brtags pa tsam/ /ci tsam snang ba gsal bas sems yin te/ /rmi lam la sogs dag dang mtshungs phyir dang*/ /blo dang lhan cig kho nar dmigs pas kyang*/ /sems snang tsam yin gzhan du med par grub/ /yang 'phags pas gsungs pa/ yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang*/ /lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /don ni don du grub gyur na/ /shes pa rtogs pa med mi 'gyur/ /'di la su zhig blo ldan zhing*/ /zhi ba thob pa grub pa yi/ /chos kun yid la byed pa la/

/de ltar don rnams snang phyir dang*/ /mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med phyir yang*/ /don med khong du chud par bya/ /de lta bas na rnam rig med/ /slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ drug gis gcig char sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag kyang go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ /de ni gcig na'ang yul min la/ /phra rab rdul du du ma'ang min/ /de dag 'dus pa'ang ma yin te/ /'di ltar rdul phran mi 'grub phyir/ /rnam pa'i grangs bzhin shes pa yod 'dod na/ /rags pa bzhin du dpyad pas 'jig par 'gyur/ /du ma shes pa gcig gi ngor bden na/ /sna tshogs ngo bor snang ba'i dngos gcig la/ /dngos gcig bden na rnam pa mang po brdzun/ /rnam pa bden na dngos gcig nyams par 'gyur/ /'phags pa nā gardzu nas kyang*/ /ji ltar skad cig mtha' yod pa/ /de bzhin thog dang dbus brtag dgos/ /de ltar skad cig gsum brtag phyir/ /'jig rten skad cig gnas pa min/ /thog ma dbus dang tha ma yang*/ /skad cig bzhin du bsam par bya/ /thog ma dbus dang tha ma dag /rang gzhan las kyang ma yin no/ /shes pa cha med yul phrad shes na ni/ /phrad rjes rigs pas cha med 'gal ba yin/ /ma phrad shes par 'gal la gcig par zhugs/ /'jug dang zhugs zin phyir na cha bcas so/ /bdag med gtan tshigs gtso bo gnyis su mthong*/ / dngos rnams ngo bos ma grub gang phyir 'di/ /chos yin gcig dang du mar ma grub phyir/ /de ltar gtan tshigs rtsa sbyor 'god bya ste/ /phyogs chos gcig 'gog tshul rnams sngar bstan zin/ /du ma gcig gcig bsags las byung ba'i phyir/ /gcig med phyir na du ma khegs pa yin/ /de gnyis ngo bo phan tshun 'gal ba'ang ste/ /du mar snang ba du ma'i phyir na brdzun/ /gcig na bden pa srid kyang gcig mi srid/ /spyod yul gyur la phung gsum yod ma yin/ /gcig min du ma min pas brdzun par grub/

khyab sgrub dpe ni me long gzugs brnyan te/ /rang bzhin yod min de ni me long las/ /gzhan min gcig tu grub min phyir zhes 'god/ /mtshan nyid mi mtshungs phyir na gcig pa min/ /gcig gi go sar gnyis med phyir gzhan med/ /skabs 'di'i bden med don ni mngon sum grub/ /de phyir tha snyad rtags kyis sgrub par 'dod/ /gcig dang du mar med na rdzas dngos min/ /der yod gang rung las gzhan ma dmigs phyir/ /de gnyis phan tshun spangs te gnas phy-ir ro/ /zhes pas ldog pa sgrub par 'dod pa yin/ /gcig dang du bral rang bzhin med pas khyab/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin te phyi nang dngos 'di yang*/ /de dang bral phyir de med ces bkod pas/ /rig shes rjes dpag bskyed par 'dod pa yin/ /'on kyang lugs 'di don la ston pa'i phyir/ /don grub na ni tshig la khyad par med/ /yan lag gnyis lnga ci 'dod sbyor du rung*/ /ngo bo 'gog pa rigs pa'i rtsa ba 'di'o/ /khyad par 'gog pa mtha' bzhi skye 'gog ste/ /dngos rnams skye med bdag sogs mi skye'i phyir/ /mig sogs bdag las mi skye yod phyir dang*/ /skye ba rkyen gzhan la ltos mthong phyir ro/ /bdag gis byed na byed po ma skyes pas/ /med phyir de yis byed pa ga la rung*/ /rang nyid grub na bskyed byed dgos pa med/ /ma grub pas ni ji ltar bskyed par byed/ /gzhan las min te sa bon la ltos phyir/ /de mi ltos na rgyu dang rgyu min pa/ /mnyam gyur sa bon la phan mi dgos phyir/ /zhig zin gzhan las skye na rgyu med 'gyur/ /ma zhig las skyes dus mnyam phan tshun nyid/ / 'gags dang ma 'gag las gzhan 'gag bzhin pa/ /med phyir de las skyes pa'ang mi rung ngo*/ /rkyen gzhan rnams las byung yang byed po min/ /gzhan skyes snang ba de ni brtags ngor yin/ /myu gu'i dus na med phyir sa bon te/ /rang min rgyud gcig gtogs phyir gzhan yang min/

/sa bon myu gu yod med phan tshun du/ /rnam par dpyad pas de la'ang skye ba med/ /gnyis skye 'dod la gnyis ka'i skyon yin te/ /sngo sogs bkag na khra bo mi 'grub bzhin/ /gnyis skye rang dbang ma yin ltos las grub/ /rgyu med nam yang skye dang nam yang min/ /res 'ga' skye mthong grags pas gnod pa'ang yin/ khyab sgrub dngos por skye na de bzhir nges/ /dngos la rang gzhan gnyis kyis khyab phyir ro/ /bzhi las mi skye rang bzhin skye med khyab/ /rus sbal spu bzhin dngos po 'di dag kyang*/ /de med phyir na skye ba med ces bya/ /rtags grub dus na don ni grub zin pas/ /de de'i tha snyad dngos su gtso bor bsgrub/ /ltos grub rigs pas kun brtags khegs mod kyang*/ /dngos po'i ngo bor dpyod na stobs ldan min/ kha cig gtan med min te rten 'brel phyir/ /zer ba 'dis ni grub zin bsgrub par 'dod/ /yod med skye 'gog mu bzhi dpyod pa sogs/ /'phros don phra mo yin par shes par bya/ /'gag gnas med de skye ba med phyir dang*/ /tha dad min te gcig pa med phyir dang*/ /'ong ba med de song ba ma grub dang*/ /chad pa med de rtag pa med phyir zhais/ /'di rnams rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs bla na med/ /dbu ma'i gzhung gi gtan tshigs mtha' dag kyang*/ /'di rnams kho na'i rjes 'brang yin phyir ro/ / chos kun bdag med gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba yod min te/ /dgag bya log tshul sgo nas ldog pas dbye/ /theg pa chung dang chen po'i rigs so sor/ /rjes su bzung phyir rgyal bas 'di gnyis gsungs/ /'di yi yul gyi dgag bya dngos mi srid/ /yul can dgag bya log rtog yin phyir zlog /dngos na yod med su yis dgag sgrub nus/ /de bzhin nyid la kun rdzob chos kyi bdag /nam yang med pa chos kyi bdag med de/ /don dam las gzhan chos rnams rang ngo bor/

/gdod nas ma grub de yang rnam grangs pa/ /rnam grangs mngon lkog chos kun gang la yang*/ /bdag dngos nam yang mi srid de tsam la/ /gang zag bdag med zhes su tha snyad mdzod/ /chos rnams kun la 'di gnyis khyab pa'i phyir/ /chos kun gyi ni spyi yi mtshan nyid do/ /rje btsun gyis kyang*/ rang dang rang gi bdag nyid du/ /med phyir rang gi ngo bo la/ /mi gnas phyir dang 'dzin bzhin te/ /med phyir ngo bo nyid med 'dod/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i rten yin pas/ /ngo bo nyid ni med pa yis/ /skye med 'gag med gzod nas zhi/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa 'grub/ /thog ma dang ni de nyid gzhan nyid dang*/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan du 'gyur/ /kun nas nyos mongs pa dang khyad par las/ /skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod par bshad/ /de dag skye ba gtan med rnam grangs te/ /ri mo'i dpe dang chu rnyog dwangs pa sogs/ /skye ba bden par med pa'i rnam grangs so/ /skye med dgongs pa'ang de ltar shes par byos/ /snying po rtag pa gang zag bdag med dang*/ /rnam pa kun ldan khyab pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /chos bdag med pa'i stong gzhir dgongs pa yin/ /'di ni sgra rtog dgag sgrub yul las 'das/ /gcig dang tha dad skye 'gag spros dang bral/ /de phyir sngar gyi rigs pas mi khegs te/ khang ba'i mtshan nyid bkag pas ljon shing bzhin/ /bdag med gnyis kyi dgag phyogs don dam pa'i/ / rnam grangs tsam yin stong gzhi don dam dngos/ /'di na gzhi lam 'bras chos 'ga' yang med/ /sangs rgyas chos sku kho na bden par gnas/ /don dam dpyod byed rigs pa kun gyi gnad*/ /gang gang de de'i ngo bo khyad par sogs/ / gcig dang tha dad dpyod dam 'gal ba tshol/ /yin phyir dpyod tshul thams cad de la 'dus/ /thal rang gzhung rnams bden pa'i de de med/ /yod na 'di ltar yod dgos zhes smra ba'i/ /gsang tshig 'di ni gang dgos kun la sbyor/ /'di ni dpyad na rigs pa min pa mang*/

/bya byed bden pa mi srid ci ste bden/ /ltos med tha dad kho na dgos zhes pa/ /ri bong mgo la rwa med yod na ni/ /dkar por yod kyi gzhan min zer dang mtshungs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka mi 'dod dngos mi srid/ /de 'dra'i mtshan nyid 'jog pa blun po'i lugs/ /brtags don tshol byed ltar snang kun bor nas/ /yang dag rigs pa'i lam la 'jug par byos/ /zhes pa bdag med gnyis gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste drug pa'o// //de ltar bshad pa'i grub don bden gnyis la/ /nges pa yang dag rnyed nas bsgom phyir yin/ /bden gnyis shes na lta spyod rnam par dag /drang nges don la blo mchog thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo bden stong rnam shes kyi/ /yul ni kun rdzob tsam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ /rang gi ngo bo bden grub 'phags pa yi/ /ye shes spyod yul don dam bden par 'dod/ /rgyal tshab chen po nas kyang*/ byis pa yang dag nyid bsgribs nas/ /yang dag ma yin kun tu snang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bsal nas/ /yang dag nyid ni kun tu snang*/ /don med pa dang don yod dag /mi snang snang ba yin zhes bya/ /thog med bsags pa'i ma rig bag chags la/ /'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad gsal snang can/ /blang dor bya ba'i yul du 'os pa ni/ /yang dag kun rdzob ces byar mkhas rnams 'dod/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i dngos yul kun brtags dang*/ /'phral gyi 'phrul rgyus snang ba gang yin dang*/ /grub mtha' log pas btags pa'i don spyi rnams/ /log pa'i kun rjob nyid du nges par brjod/ /yang dag kun rjob 'jig rten rnal 'byor gnyis/ /ma brtags phyi nang snang ba 'jig rten pa'i/ /gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam ni rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de la rigs pa'i sgrub byed 'jug mod kyang*/ /gsal bar snang ba ma brtags ngor yin pas/ /snang ba sems ni dpyad ngo kho nar min/ /don dam rigs pas grub kyang de min bzhin/ /yang dag don la sgrib phyir kun rdzob dang*/

/mchog gi rtogs bya yin phyir don dam mo/ /kun rdzob bden pa kun rdzob kho nar bden/ /don dam kho nar bden pa don dam ste/ /zhen ngor bden snang ngor bden pa gnyis/ /kun rdzob yin phyir spyir ni brdzun pa nyid/ /kun rdzob yul can rnam shes 'khor dang bcas/ /don dam yul can ye shes kho na stai/ /lam ni yul can don dam rjes su 'jug /rtogs byed dngos ni rang yin dbye ba med/ /rjais dpag rigs shes dbang yid kun rdzob 'jal/ /don dam rtogs byed rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /dam pa'i don gyi spyi 'jal rigs shes yod/ /rang rig kun rdzob don dam gnyis su 'byed/ /'jig rten grags ngor kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ /rang lugs kun rdzob tsam dang kun rdzob bden/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis la rim bzhin sbyaur/ /kun rdzob la yang rang gi kun rdzob dang*/ /don dam gnyis yin gnyis dang rnam shes tsam/ /don dam dbye ba rnam grangs khyab pa gnyis/ /kun rdzob rang bzhin med tsam rnam grangs pa/ /spros bral tsam dang stong pa tsam po'ang de/ /bden med ji bzhin ma go tshig spyi tsam/ /ji bzhin go na spros par mi 'char bas/ /blo dman don du bden med sogs 'gog kyang*/ / bden med spros bral stong tsam dbye ba med/ khyab pa'i don dam snying po'i ye shes so/ /yang na don dam nyid la'ang bden gnyis dbye/ /gnyis bral cha dang ye shes ldog pas dbye/ /bden gnyis dbye gzhi srid tshad shes bya tsam/ /blo gnyis rtogs tshul gnyis dang 'khor 'das dang*/ /spyod po skye 'phags phyir ni dgos pas dbye/ /ye shes ngor byas bden pa gcig pu nyid/ /bden pa 'di dag gcig pa bkag pa ste/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas gcig dang tha dad min/ /gcig na kun rdzob mthong bas grol ba dang*/ /gcig shos nyon mongs dmigs par 'gyur ba dang*/ /de la dbye ba med ltar kun rdzob 'gyur/ /mthong thos las gzhan don dam btsal med 'gyur/
