/gzhan na don dam mthong yang kun rdzob la/ /'dzin mi zlog dang chos nyid min pa dang*/ /kun rdzob med pa don dam mi 'gyur dang*/ / gnyis ka dus gcig dmigs par thal zhes gsungs/ /don dam mtshan nyid gnyis la ci rigs sbyor/ /bden gnyis rang bzhin rnam par gzhag pa ni/ / mgon po slob dpon gzhan dang bdag tshigs spel/ /chos can sgyu ma lta bur bden stong snang*/ /chos nyid 'gyur med gnyis stong ye shes bden/ /gzung ba sgyu 'dra bstan pa'i dgos par bcas/ /'dzin pa sgyu 'dra sgyu ma'i dpe rnams so/ /ji ltar sgyu ma de bzhin du/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog brjod/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa ji lta ba/ /de bzhin gnyis su 'khrul bar brjod/ /ji ltar de la de med pa/ /de bzhin du ni don dam 'dod/ /ji ltar de ni dmigs pa ltar/ /de bzhin du ni kun rdzob 'dod/ /ces pa'i don dam kun rdzob ni/ /gnas skabs pa la bzhag pa ste/ /rnam par rig pa tsam de yang*/ /gnas skabs pa yi don dam yin/ /de med na ni de yi rgyu/ /gsal bar dmigs pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin gnas ni gzhan gyur na/ /yang dag ma yin rtog pa dmigs/ /ji ltar 'jig rten ma 'khrul ba/ /de yi rgyu la 'dod dgur spyod/ /de bzhin sdom brtson ma 'khrul ba/ /gnas gzhan gyur la dgyes dgur spyod/ /de lta bu ni de la yod/ / de yi dngos po yod ma yin/ /de ltas sgyu ma la sogs la/ /yod dang med pa nyid du brjod/ /de la yod pa med ma yin/ /med pa yod pa nyid ma yin/ /sgyu ma dag la sogs pa la/ /yod med khyad par med pa'ang brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis snang de la yod/ /de yi dngos po yod ma yin/ /de ltas gzugs la sogs pa la/ / yod dang med pa nyid du brjod/ /de la yod pa med ma yin/ /med pa yod pa nyid ma yin/ /gzugs la sogs pa dag la ni/ /yod med khyad par med pa'ang brjod/ /sgro 'dogs pa dang skur ba yi/ /mtha' rnams dgag par bya phyir

dang*/ /theg pa dman pas 'gro ba dag /dgag pa'i phyir ni 'dod pa yin/ / 'khrul ba'i rgyu dang 'khrul ba ni/ /gzugs kyi rnam par rig pa dang*/ /gzugs can min rnam rig par 'dod/ /med phyir gcig shos kyang med 'gyur/ /sgyu ma'i glang po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /'khrul phyir gnyis su brjod pa ste/ /de la ji bzhin gnyis med kyang*/ /gnyis po dag tu nye bar dmigs/ /keng rus kyi ni gzugs 'dzin pa/ /'khrul phyir gnyis su brjod pa ste/ /de la ji bzhin gnyis med kyang*/ /gnyis po dag tu nye bar dmigs/ /'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid chos gang yin/ /de bzhin yod dang de bzhin med/ /yod med khyad par med pa'i phyir/ /yod dang med dang sgyu ma 'dra/ / gnyen po'i chos ni gang yin pa/ /de bzhin med dang de bzhin yod/ /de bzhin med phyir mtshan nyid med/ /sgyu ma dang yang 'dra bar bstan/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal pos sgyu ma yi/ /rgyal po gzhan zhig pham pa ltar/ /gang dag gis ni chos mthong ba'i/ /rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med/ / sangs rgyas rnam sangs rgyas mchog rnams kyis de dang de las 'dus byas rnams/ /gsungs pa sgyu ma rmi lam smig rgyu gzugs brnyan dang 'dra mig yor dang*/ /brag cha lta bu dang ni chu zla'i gzugs 'dra sprul ba 'drar shes bya/ /drug dang drug dang gnyis dang drug tshan gnyis dang gsum por re rer 'dod/ /don dam mtshan nyid yod min med min sogs/ /spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba sngar bshad zin/ /rang rig la sogs mtshan nyid lnga dang gsum/ /slob dpon klu yis kyang ni bshad pa'o/ /gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang*/ /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rnam rtog med don tha dad min/ /de ni de nyid mtshan nyid do/ / rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcos min dang*/ /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /brjod par bya ba bzlog pas ni/ /sems kyi spyod yul bzlog pas so/

/gnyis dngos med pa'i dngos med pa'i/ /dngos po stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yod pa ma yin med pa'ang min/ /tha dad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid min/ /stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang*/ /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnam grangs don de go rim bzhin/ /za ba bza' dang de yi lus/ /gnas kyi gzhi yi stong pa nyid/ /de yang gang gis ji ltar mthong*/ / gang phyir de yang stong pa nyid/ /dge gnyis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu sems can phan bya'i phyir/ /'khor ba btang bar mi bya'i phyir/ /dge ba mi zad bya ba'i phyir/ /rigs kyang rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrub par byed/ /gang zag dang ni chos rnams kyi/ /dngos po med 'dir stong pa nyid/ /de dngos med pa'i dngos yod pa/ /de ni de las stong nyid gzhan/ /gal te nyon mongs de ma gyur/ /lus can thams cad grol bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnam dag de ma gyur/ /'bad pa 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /chos dbyings bden de grub dang brdzun min phyir/ /ye shes mthong ba brdzun par mi 'thad phyir/ /bden grub min yang bden zhes don bral smra/ /mi 'dod der thal de rig dgag bya'i phyir/ /bden de gnas tshul nyid la zhugs phyir ro/ /bden gnyis gnas tshul min na gnas tshul med/ /brdzun par mnyam na yin min khyad par ci/ /bden min rdzun pa rdzun min bden pa ste/ /sgra don gzhan med mthun dpe'i mtshan gzhi med/ /bden rdzun phung gsum nam yang mi 'thad do/ /yod na thams cad la yang ha cang thal/ /bden min mthong ba phyin ci log shes sam/ /brdzun pa zad mtha' don dam min par 'gyur/ /ye shes kyis ni chos dbyings ma mthong na/

/shes par 'gal te yul med kho na'i phyir/ blo rang skye med gyur la de 'dod na/ /byis blos rtogs 'gyur stong nyid yin phyir ro/ /rnam pa shar na bya byed dbye bar thal/ /bden par grub ste rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis/ /shes rtogs mthong zhing myong ba'i yul phyir te/ /so so rang rig spyod yul yin phyir ro/ /yang na khyod la ye shes phyin log 'gyur/ / gnas lugs ma mthong 'khrul snang mthong phyir ro/ /rgyud chad med pa'i sangs rgyas chos kun gyi/ /rtsa ba brtan po yin phyir bden par grub/ /'khrul ba je che'i 'bras :bur gyur

(《dzaṃ》 bu 'gyur ) mang dang*/ /cung zad je chung gyur la je brtan mthong*/ /spros kun bden dang 'gal bar grub pa ste/ /don dam dbyings ni gcig dang du ma sogs/ /spros pas gos pa mi srid bden par grub/ /za ba la sogs stong gzhi'i chos can la/ /kun brtags kyis stong rnam rig tsam yod pa/ /kun rdzob bden dang stong pa'i gzhi mthun pa'o/ /de dag nam yang bden par ma grub pas/ /chos kun de dag bden med mtshan nyid can/ /stong gzhi don dam de des stong pa ni/ /thun mong tsam du don dam bden par 'dod/ /ye shes rnam pa kun ldan kun rdzob kyis/ /stong la rnam pa mthun pa'i dri ma rnams/ /ngos 'dzin phyir yin thun mong min pa'i lugs/ /'dus byas sogs la re re'i dgos pa'ang yod/ /phyi ma gnyis ni bcu bzhi kun la 'jug /mi dmigs stong nyid dngos po stong nyid dang*/ /rang mtshan gzhan mtshan stong pa rnams kyang bsnan/ /dus dang dngos med stong pa kun brtags dang*/ /lhag ma gnyis ni gzhan dbang yongs grub bo/ /yongs grub rnam grangs dgus bstan pa/ /dam pa'i don gyi bdag nyid de/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma la sogs dgus/ /mtshon pa'i don las log par bzhed/ /de bzhin nyid dang ma nor dang*/ /gzhan min chos nyid chos dbyings dang*/ /chos gnas skyon med yang dag mtha'/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i dbyings zhes bya/ /'jig med phyin ci log min dang*/ /'gyur med ngo bo nyid dang ni/ /rnam byang chos kyi rgyu nyid dang*/ /dus kun pa dang phyir mi ldog /de phyir dus dang rtog las 'das/ /rmi lam sgyu ma smig sgyu dang*/ /chu zla dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ /brag cha mig yor gzugs brnyan dang*/ /sprul pa bzhin no brdzun pa dgu/ /de las log pa don dam yin/ / brtags na ji ltar snang bzhin min/ /kun brtags chos rnams rmi lam 'dra/ / de las log pa de bzhin nyid/ /rtag tu yod de mi 'jig phyir/ /nor bar snang phyir chos thams cad/

/sgyu 'dra de las log pa ni/ /ma nor phyin log gdod nas med/ /gzhan du gnas la gzhan snang phyir/ /smig sgyu 'dra ba'i chos spangs pa/ /gzhan min dus gzhan mi 'gyur phyir/ /bdag nyid min la bdag por snang*/ /chu zla lta bu dgag don du/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul te/ /ngo bo nyid la chos nyid brjod/ /don med dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /stobs sogs rnam byang chos kun kyi/ /don dam rgyu ni dbyings su bstan/ /don yod phyir na de bcad do/ /brag cha lta bur yin thung ba/ /log pas gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /sangs rgyas byung rung ma byung rung*/ /dus thams cad du yongs su grub/ /ma nges ngo bo mig yor 'dra/ /de spong phyir du skyon med bstan/ /nges pa bden pa'i don can te/ /rtogs na byang chub la zhugs pa'o/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du rnam 'pho ba/ /med phy-ir yang dag mtha' yin te/ /de kho na nyid don dam la/ /yul dang blo yi 'pho 'gyur med/ /rtog ge las 'das bsam mi khyab/ /so so rang rig sgra rtog spangs/ /sems yid 'du byed spyod yul chos/ /sprul pa lta bur gdod nas dag /mdo tshig la 'khrul 'jig rten stobs ldan zer/ /lus gtsang ba dang bdag yun gnas pa dang*/ /'jig rten byed pos byas par khas longs shig /kun la mthun par snang ba rnyed par dka'/ /nyon mongs ye shes zhes pa 'di la dpyad/ /chos kun ma lus rang bzhin ye shes la/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog kho nar dpyad pas ci/ /rang ldog nyid nas ye shes yin na ni/ /rjes mthud rnam rtog yod med khyad ci yod/ /gnyis pa de yang ye shes yin phyir dang*/ /de la'ang rjes mthud med na mtshungs phy-ir ro/ /gdod nas skad cig dang po'i de mi srid/ /skad cig de yang dus mtha' mi mngon pas/ /bya rdzogs yin na las byed mngon sum mthong*/ /dang po ye shes yin na des bsags pa'i/ /las rnams zag pa med pa'i las su thal/ /rang bzhin yin yang dgos pas logs su smos/

/snyam na mi 'gal 'on kyang brda don 'khrul/ /rang bzhin shes na de 'gag de yod na/ /rang bzhin mi shes phyir na de gnyis 'gal/ /chos de las gzhan chos nyid btsal med sogs/ /lung la 'khrul nas gnas lugs yin 'dod rmongs/ /thabs mkhas khyad par ldan pas bsgyur ba na/ /lam du 'gyur bar kun la grags bzhin 'dod/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor kun rdzob gyi/ /mtha' gnyis sel dang spong ba'i tshul/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /'di ni bden gnyis dbyer med tshul/ /'khor 'das sogs la'ang 'di ltar sbyaur/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i glo bur gyis/ /stong dang rnam dbyer med chos can/ /bla med chos kyi mi stong pa/ /shin tu thun mong min pa ste/ /'di ni don dam kho na la/ /mtha' gnyis sel ba'i tshul yin no/ /yod la yod dang med la med shes pa/ /gnas lugs tshul la rjes mthun shes pa yin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid spyi yi mtshan nyid dang*/ /brda dang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /yod med la sogs khyad par dbye bar bya/ /dang po'ang don dam mtshan ma da lta bar/ /yod pa'i dbye bas gsum du 'gyur ba yin/ /mtshan ma ming las don ni ma nor dang*/ /brda ni don la ming du ma nor ba/ /ma skyes 'gags zin gcig la gcig med dang*/ /gtan med kun rdzob med dang don dam med/ /med pa'i tshul yang so sor dbye bar bya/ /sems ni rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod/ /de ni glo bur nyes pas ma rung byas/ /chos nyid sems las gzhan pa'i sems gzhan ni/ /'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin la brjod do/ /chos med pa dang dmigs pa dang*/ /kun nas nyon mongs med rnam dag /sgyu ma la sogs 'dra ba dang*/ /de bzhin nam mkha' 'drar shes bya/ /chos kyis rab tu phye ba ni/ /'khor ba yin te chos nyid kyis/ /rab tu phye ba theg gsum gyi/ /mya ngan las ni 'das pa'o/

/de la chosakyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gnyis dang ji ltar mngon brjod par/ /snang ba'i yang dag min pa yi/ /kun rtog pa de med snang phyir/ /des na yang dag min pa'o/ /de yang thams cad don med cing*/ /rtog tsam yin pas kun rtog pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa dang*/ /brjod par bya dang rjod par byed/ /khyad med de bzhin nyid yin no/ /brtags pa dang ni shes pa dang*/ /de bzhin brjod par rags pa yin/ /don dang thob dang sgrub pa ni/ /don dam rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /don dam gnyis kyang gnas skabs su/ /bslu ba med phyir don dam brjod/ /kun brtags gzung 'dzin med par bden/ /gzhan dbang kun brtags bral bar bden/ /zhes pa bden pa gnyis gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o// //theg gcig nyid dang dgra bcom sems bslad dang*/ /gang zag brgyad med la sogs drang don no/ /mthar thug theg gsum kyang ste theg gcig nyid/ /sde snod dgongs gcig mthar thug bgrod bya gcig /lam gyi ngo bo gcig ste byang chub sems/ /gnyis ni stong pa'i ye shes snying rje che/ /gsum ni de steng thabs kyi tshogs sgrub pa/ /bzhi ni chos la mos pa la sogs te/ /rgyu gsum 'dod 'ga' klu yi tshig la 'khrul/ /rnam grangs brjod na thabs mkhas la sogs 'chad/ /gtso bo brjod 'dod na ni snying rje dang*/ /byang chub sems kyi dbye ba lhag par 'gyur/ /chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i/ /kun ldang drag dang bag chags dang*/ /mthong sgom lam spangs ma dag dang*/ /dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi/ /dri ma rnam dgu pad+ma yi/ /sbubs sogs dpes ni rab bstan te/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs kyi ni/ /dbye ba bye ba mtha' las 'das/ /nges 'byung snying rje rten 'brel zhi gnas dang*/ /bdag med stong nyid rig pas sgom la sbyaur/ /chags sogs bzhi dang gsum gnyis gnyen por sbyar/ /chos sku gsum shes chos la mos pa thob/

/de bzhin nyid shes shes rab dam pa ste/ /rigs gnyis shes na de la nan tan du/ /gnas pa dgos par rig nas bsam gtan sbyaur/ /sku gsum rigs shes 'gro la snying rje 'jug /snying po nges shes de ston chos la mos/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rjes dran gsum gyi sgo/ /de las shes rab de rjes gnon pa ni/ /zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i bsam gtan yin/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje skye/ /yul la spros pa 'gog pa'i shes rab dang*/ /yul can mtshan ma 'gog pa'i dbye bas phye/ /gzugs dang mig rten shes rab skye ba sogs/ /gnas lugs mthong tshul thun mong min par 'dod/ byis pa nyer spyod bsam gtan dang*/ /chos rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dmigs bsam gtan dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge bsam gtan/ /snying rje sems can chos dang dmigs pa med/ /chos ni mdo sder dmigs kyi gzhan ma yin/ /sdug bsngal bdag med stong pa'i rgyu can las/ /snying por la dmigs snying rje khyad par 'phags/ /mi rtag bdag med stong pa snying po rnams/ /stong nyid tshul la'ang phyi ma phyi ma mchog /sgom pa'ang sangs rgyas snying por dmigs pas 'phags/ /de phyir sa la'ang dbye ba'i khyad par che/ /'di ni nam yang 'dor min gzhan rnams 'dor/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*/ /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhags pa'i skyon lnga 'di la med/ /rang stong tsam gyis 'di dag sel mi nus/ /spro ba che dang ston pa bzhin gus dang*/ /shes rab ye shes bdag mtshungs byams chen skye/ /de ltar dad pa spyi dang khyad par bcas/ /skyabs su song zhing byang chub sems bskyed blangs/ /bsgom bya stong nyid snying rje mi gnas sbyaur/ /sgom tshul thabs ni zhi gnas lhag mthong sbrel/ /thun mtshams spyod pa chos spyod lhag ma dgu/ /thabs mkhas yi rang mos pa bsngo ba dang*/ / yan lag bdun gyis dge ba spel bar bya/

/rtag tu tshul khrims sdom pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /sdig grogs spangs dang bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ /sems gnas pa yi thabs dgu brten pa dang*/ /nyes pa lnga bsal spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ /brten tshul la sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ /zas kyi tshod rig mi nyal rnal 'byor brtson/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kho nar spyod/ /de las dang po'i las can sa thob 'gyur/ /de nas de dag sngon rol du/ /phan yon lnga ni thob 'gyur te/ /des na rnam par dag pa'i snod/ /bla na med pa nyid du 'gyur/ / lus la gnas ngan len pa kun/ /skad cig re re la zad 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni kun tu yang*/ /shin tu sbyangs pas gang bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi snang ba thams cad du/ /yongs su chad pa med rtogs 'gyur/ /yang dag pa yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /ma brtags pa dag rab tu mthong*/ /mngon shes don du gnyer bas de/ / sbyangs na las su rung ba'i mchog /bsam gtan la thob mngon par shes/ / mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo nas de/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la/ /mchod pa'i phyir dang bsnyen pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni rnams su 'gro/ /de nas de 'drar gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam bzhag pas/ /yid kyis brjod pa ma gtogs pa/ /don kun rab tu mi mthong ngo*/ /chos kyi snang ba 'phel bya'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa kun tu brtson/ /chos kyi snang ba 'phel nas ni/ / sems tsam la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas don du snang ba kun/ /sems su rab tu mthong bar 'gyur/ /de tshe de yi gzung ba yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba de spong 'gyur/ /de nas de la 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig lus/ /de tshe bar chad med pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la myur du reg /'di ltar de yi mjug thogs su/ /'dzin pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba spong*/ /'di dag go rim bzhin du ni/ /dro bar 'gyur sogs yin zhes bya/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpag med

la/ /bskal dpag med par bsnyen bkur byas/ /de la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i phyir/ /sems ni las rung mchog tu 'gyur/ /de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang*/ /ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /de yi chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ /skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na 'di/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi spyod yul ni/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis po dang*/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rten dang ni/ /de :rtag (《dzaṃ》 rten ) nyer zhi yin zhes bya/ /rnam par mi rtog rgyab kyi phyogs/ /rtag tu dga' dang ldan pa'o/ /yongs su shes dang spang ba dang*/ /mngon sum du ni bya phyir te/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu nyid du/ /chos kyi sdoms ni rnam pa bzhi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bshad/ /brtan pa rnams kyi bzhi po 'di/ /med pa'i don dang rnam rtog don/ /kun tu rtog don kho na dang*/ /rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'i don/ /de yang ting 'dzin gzungs dang chos kyi shugs/ /yon tan mtha' yas mos spyod sa 'dir thob/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad la sogs sems dpa'i yon tan mang*/ /nyan thos sogs dang thun mong mthong sgom gyi/ /spang bya mngon rgyu phal cher 'dir zlog 'gyur/ /de nas de ni 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i ye shes bla med pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dri ma med/ /'dzin pa gnyis dang bral ba 'thob/ /de 'dir gnas yongs gyur pa ste/ /sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di de bskal pa dpag med kyis/ /shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mnyam pa nyid/ /rab tu rtogs nas de yi tshe/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /bdag dang mtshungs pa'i sems thob ste/ /sems can rnams la bdag med dang*/

/ sdug bsngal dang ni don bya dang*/ /lan mi re la 'di sems snyoms/ /rgyal sras gzhan dang 'dra ba yin/ /ched du mi spong lam bsgyur ma gtogs pa'i/ khams gsum gtogs pa'i nyon mongs thams cad dang*/ /mthong spangs rigs gyur shes bya snyoms 'jug sogs/ /sgrib mang sa bon skabs der zlog par 'gyur/ /'jigs pa lnga bral ma dag lus spong ste/ /dbang po lnga rnams gnas gyur thob phyir ro/ /mthong lam ngo bo mnyam gzhag rigs gcig mod/ /ldog cha'i sgo nas skad cig tha dad 'jog /sgom spang mi spong bar du de yin zhing*/ / bsam mi khyab phyir dus ring gnas pa'ang srid/ /de nas 'di ni lhag ma yi/ /sa rnams sgom pa'i lam 'di la/ /ye shes rnam pa gnyis po dag /bsgom phyir rab tu sbyor bar byed/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes de/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sbyong bar byed/ /gzhan ni ji bzhin rnam 'jog pa/ /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /bdag med ye shes thob kyang ltung ba yi/ /rnam rtog phra mo shes bzhin min srid par/ /dang po nyid yin de spangs gnyis pa'o/ /ting 'dzin 'jig rten pa kun gcig char nus/ /thos pa kun 'dzin gsum pa yin par 'dod/ /byang phyogs dbang thob ting 'dzin chos srid zlog /bden bzhi la brten sems la dbang sgyur bas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das la mngon phyogs min/ /de bzhin rten 'brel ches sgom 'gog thob las/ /'khor bas mi skyo dbyings la mngon du phyogs/ /gzhan ni rtsol bcas mtshan med dbang thob dang*/ /lhun grub mi skye chos la bzod pa dang*/ /so so rig bzhis zhing kun dga' bskyed dang*/ /chos sku bde gshegs snying po yongs rtogs pa/ /de dag yod med thob dang ma thob las/ /sa rnams gong nas gong du 'pho tshul shes/ /ji srid ji lta ji snyed shes bya la/ /gcig char chags thogs med pa'i ye shes ni/ /ma thob bar du byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'on kyang 'di ni rjes mthun rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don/ /rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang*/ /yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang*/ /rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang*/ /nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang*/ /tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang*/ /bri med 'phel ba med don dang*/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas/ /de yang rnam par mi rtog bcas/ /zhing la dbang ba brgyad pa yin/ /dgu pa mnyam gzhag ye shes dbang*/ /bcu pa rjes thob las la dbang*/ /phyin bcu'ang sa bcur spyod pa dang*/ /zhing rnam du mar rnam smin tshul/ /'dzam gling dbang phyug nas brtsam nas/ /gnas gtsang bdag po'i bar du'o/ /so skye'i bskal pa'i bar gyi tshogs kyi tshad/ /sa thob pas ni skad cig re rer bsgrub/ /bdun pa man chad bskal pa stong gi tshogs/ /dag pa'i sa la gnas pas skad cig la'o/ /dbang bskur ma thob bskal pagrangs med pa'i/ /tshogs kyang de thob skad cig re rer bzlums/ /gsum pa'i 'jig rten ting 'dzin bsam gtan yang*/ khams gsum gyi min byang sems kho na'i yin/ /nyan thos rang rgyal thams cad rmongs 'gyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin 'bum phrag bcu ni bdun par thob/ /spyod yul shes pas nyan rang kun zil gnon/ /dbang bsgyur ma gtogs nyon sgrib bag la nyal/ /thams cad sa 'dir shin tu rnam par dag /'di yi mthar ni mtshan 'dzin dag 'gyur bas/ /kun gzhi rigs mthun gcig gis zhing kun 'gro/ /dbang bskur thob la mthun mi mthun dbyer med/ /dbang bcu phra mo rab dga'i sa la thob/ /chen po phyag gi dbang bcas mi g.yo la'o/ /brgya dang stong phrag 'bum dang khrag khrig dang*/ /rab bkrams che dang dkrigs dang ded 'dren gyi/ /yon tan rnams ni ma dag sa la 'dod/ /stong gsum sa ya grangs med sa ya dag /sa gnyis po la tshad de mos ngor gsungs/ /ting 'dzin sangs rgyas zhing g.yo der 'gro dang*/ / 'od dang yongs smin bskal gnas mngon shes dang*/ /chos sgo 'khor bcas lus kyang ston par byed/

/chos sprin yon tan tshad las 'das pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang rjes su mthun/ /bstan dang gzugs sku dag dang ni/ /spyod dang spyod lam gyis kyang rung*/ /gang zhig ji ltar gang gis 'dul/ /des de de lta nyid du shes/ /de ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /'gro la rtag tu lhun grub par/ /thogs med blo ldan de yis ni/ /sems can don ni yang dag 'grub/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /sa rnams kun la blo ldan gyi/ /rab byung len pas thob pa dang*/ /chos nyid kyis ni thob pa gzhan/ /rab tu byung bar ston byed yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni/ /gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni/ /ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor ba'i/ /dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin/ /mos spyod par ni ting 'dzin lus thob la/ /'phags sar dbang lnga gnas gyur yid lus te/ /ting 'dzin bde la snyoms 'jug sa bdun la/ /chos kyi de nyid khong chud gnyis la'o/ /ris su lhan skyes 'du byed bde ba ni/ /dbang bskur mchog thob sangs rgyas sar brjod do/ /don dam 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob pa dang*/ /bdag lta'i bag chags yid ni log gyur pas/ /rtsa ba sprul pa'i dbyer med zhing kun tu/ /lus dang yo byad zhing khams dpag med ston/ /dman pa'i dgra bcom phung po rags pa bor/ /dang por yid lus der thob 'od kyis bskul/ /de tshe mthu ldan yid lus thob ces bya/ /lhag bcas rnams kyi dbang po'i lus de yang*/ /theg chen lus thob tshe ni bskal par gnas/ /de la brten nas yid kyi lus bsgrub bo/ /slob pa 'dod par smon lam sprul pas bsgrub/ /lhag med rang gis mi shes mthu dang bral/ /mos spyod rags lus gzhan du ma gyur pas/ /de dag yid lus dngos su mi 'jog la/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni ye shes nyag gcig yin/

/ yid lus de dag bco brgyad khams dang bral/ /ye shes dbang pas ye shes 'dod yon spyod/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'chi 'pho skye ba ston/ /'jig rten 'das de'i bla ma'i dge rtsa las/ /byung zhes mdo las zhing khams mang la gsungs/ / bde ba can sogs lam gyi bden pa dang*/ /'og min chen po 'gog pa'i snang bar 'dod/ /ting 'dzin lus thob mngon par dga' ba dang*/ /yid lus dang po bde ba can zhing dbang*/ /gnyis pa rnam snang zhing gnon gsum pas ni/ /'og min chen po la yang dbang ba yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ / thun mong dge las de snang ste/ /rgyal ba kho na'i dge ba ni/ /rang snang 'og min chen po'o/ /mi mthun pa dang gnyen po dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dang rtog pa yi/ / rags 'bring phra mo ring rjes 'brel/ /rtog pa bzhi ni rim gyis spong*/ /sgra yi rjes 'gro bzod pa 'di bstan te/ /bsam pas sgom pa rjes su mthun pa dang*/ /thos pa las byung de ni skye ba med/ /'di la gang bslabs de ni byang chub lam/ /dang po mos spyod gnyis pa rab dga' dang*/ /gsum pa mi g.yo'i sa yin de gsum la/ /rang dang 'tsham par rgyal bas der lung ston/ /rgyas par mdo nyid gsal ba mnyan par bya/ /dbang rnon sems ma bskyed pa'ang lung ston srid/ /dbang rtul sems bskyed lung ston nga rgyal can/ /lkog tu lung ston de gsum ma nges la/ /bzod thob dngos su lung ston rgyas gsal nges/ /grangs med gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis/ /sgom pa yi ni mthar phyin te/ /sgom pa'i tha ma thob nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rtog pa'i mi shigs thob nas ni/ /gnas gzhan gyur pa mthar thug pa/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /gang la gnas na sems can kun/ /phan phyir rab tu sgrub byed la/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i gzhir gyur pa/

/spros bral ye shes don dam rnam kun can/ /kun rdzob snang ba med kyang kun mkhyen pa/ /chos nyid gdod ma de ni chos kyi sku/ /bden phyir snang dang gcig phyir ji lta bas/ /rang nyid rang snang rang rig tshul du mkhyen/ /rnam pa thams cad pa ni ji snyed mkhyen/ /kun rdzob ji snyed pa yi chos nyid du/ /song ba'i tshul gyis de dang de mkhyen te/ /dngos su snang ba min yang 'gro rnams la/ /de der snang ba nges par mkhyen pa nyid/ /mngon shes ldan pas gzhan gyi rmi lam bzhin/ /de nyid rang snang zhing dang sku dang 'khor/ /mchod pa gsung dbyangs bcas pa longs sku dngos/ /stug po'i zhing na nges pa lnga ldan pa/ /de ni gzhan don snang tshul longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas gtsang chen por sprul pa'i sku re las/ /'dzam gling sogs su bye ba phrag brgya ston/ /mchog gi sprul sku rtsa ba yan lag gnyis/ /sprul ba po ni thugs rjes dbyings nyid du/ /rang snang mdzad pa ston pa de nyid yin/ /stong dang gsal dang snying rje'i ye shes las/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa shar/ /chags rtog gnas gyur bde chen sku yang 'dod/ /rnam shes rigs rgyun gnas gyur ye shes lnga/ /gzhan snang 'gro don rgyu yin dus mnyams 'dres/ /skad cig gnyis pa gsar thob rnams la 'jug /dngos la kun rdzob chos ni der gnas min/ /rtsa ba'i rnam shes chos dbyings 'dra mtshungs dang*/ /me long dngos ni rnam smin cha ru 'dod/ /chos dbyings ye shes don dam kho na ste/ /gzhan rnams kun rdzob don dam gnyis su dbye/ /don dam ye shes lnga ni ngo bo gcig /phung po lnga sogs chos dbyings kho nar gnas/ /chos kyis phye na rnam shes me long lta/ /mnyam nyid tshor dang 'du shes so sor rtog /'du byed bya sgrub gzugs ni chos dbyings sbyor/ /don dam chos kun gzigs dang spros pas dben/ /rnam kun mkhyen dang mdzad 'phrin don kun mkhyen/

/rnam par mi rtog rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /gsar thob cha ni ye shes bzhi la yod/ /ji lta mkhyen dang ji lta'i cha nas mnyam/ /ji snyed mkhyen dang kun rdzob las kun mkhyen/ /sems yid yid shes dbang rnams gnas gyur te/ /lam bden dang pos chos nyid yul du byas/ /de 'og gsar byung lam bden gzhan la 'dres/ /de phyir 'di ni dngos po yin phyir 'jig /chos dbyings gdod ma yin la 'jig pa med/ /kun gyi rang bzhin yin phyir sku gsung sogs/ /kun khyab rung gis rang bzhin min na min/ /sangs rgyas don dam yin yang de thob pa/ /kun rdzob blo dang sbyar nas rnam par gzhag /ngo bo dbyer med rnam pa kun 'char ba/ /rtag la rim pa lta bu mang mtha' yas/ /don dam phyogs la 'gal 'dus skyon med de/ /bsam gyis mi khyab spyod yul kho na'i phyir/ /yon tan sde tshan bcu dgu la sogs te/ /mkhyen pa'i phyogs nas stobs bcu gtso bor smros/ /gzhan la phan mdzad thugs rje chen po ste/ /rnam grangs sgo nas bcu drug dbye bar 'dod/ /thugs rje de las 'phrin las zad med 'byung*/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal chung dang zad par mdzad/ /'khor ba'i bde dge nyan thos rang rgyal dang*/ /byang chub mchog la dbang po'i rim pas 'god/ /skal ldan mchog la mi sbyor mi srid de/ /skal dman rnams ni rang gi las dang sbyor/ /cho 'phrul gsum ni sngon du 'gro ba ste/ /don dam bde mdzad 'phrin las mthar thug go /brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang*/ /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /ston dang gsung dang khyab pa dang*/ /sprul dang ye shes spro ba dang/ /thugs gsung sku yi gsang ba dang*/ / thugs rje rnams kyi 'phrin las dpe/ /de ltar sku dang ye shes dang*/ /zhing rnams kyi ni khyad par dang*/ /yon tan rnams dang 'phrin las te/ /don 'di 'bras bur shes par bya/

/zhes pa lam dang 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// //gzhung lugs shin tu rgya che'i nang nas 'di/ /mdo tsam blangs te gzhan la phan par nus/ /bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'i rigs pa'ang 'ga'/ /don dang mthun na 'gal ba med snyam bris/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos 'di skal ba mchog /blo ldan 'ga' yis spyod yul kho na las/ /grub par rlom dang mkhas pa cher grags pa/ /mang po'i bsod nams skal bar 'di ma shong*/ /don dam rang stong lta ba'i sher phyin mdo/ /skye bar sbyangs pa bas kyang tshul 'di la/ /mos pas lan cig bklags pa'ang ches mchog nyid/ /mi mthun bgegs rnams sel bar kun tu mthong*/ /rang stong mkhas pa'i gzhung la thos bsam sgom/ /lo brgyar 'bad las byams pa'i gzhung lugs kyi/ /glegs bam spyi bor blangs ba'ang byang chub nye/ /der 'bad ngan 'gro'i lam yang ma khegs dang*/ /'dir mos brtson pa bral ba'ang lhar 'gro ba'i/ /mtshan ma mngon gyur grags shing grub phyir te/ /bde dang phun tshogs thar ba'ang de dang mtshungs/ /skal bzang yod na lam 'dir 'bad par rigs/ /de skad smra ba tā ra nā tha ste/ /blun yang mos pa'i dge ba phun tshogs kyis/ /gya nom thob pas chos la dad pa dang*/ / phan sems brtse bar ldan pa'i dbang gis so/ /zhes theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa las/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' bstan pa 'di ni/ 7kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o/ /gcig zhus/ dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 'di bzhengs dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs dge kun mud tshal/ /yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar ba'i dpal/
/srid mtha'i bar du nyams med shog/ //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 44 -- PAGE 45 -- PAGE 12 -
